excerpts.post: Your subconscious mind is aware of your preincarnative choices and will bias your perception of your dreams in the way you have preincarnatively chosen to learn certain lessons, if you can keep that contact with your subconscious mind continuous. This is a process that will reveal to you why you are here, what you were meant to learn, those other entities within your life pattern who play a role in what you are here to learn.

excerpts.t: Of course, this takes a certain aspect of will on the social memory complexes part to access it. And there is an exchange as they receive it. They also offer it their own experiences, and the needs of that social memory complex will dictate what is available to them in that moment. For it would be unnatural for a social memory complex to play or be curious, you may say, with such a repository. For as you enter into the fourth density and continue progressing along that path, the desire to serve others becomes so great that satisfying one’s curiosity is no longer a question, but rather the need to further the service to others is the most pressing need of a fourth-density social memory complex, and most fifth-density and sixth-density social memory complexes as well.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have another question in a series of questions about the concept of a social memory complex. In 16.32 of The Ra Contact, Ra says each member of the Confederation of Planets voluntarily places its social memory complex data in a social thought complex available to all. Can you say more about the central data repository and what it contains? Does it include the entirety of each member’s memories? For instance, does it include their skills, their skills gardening or carpentry or drag racing or whatever? Or is it something more abstract? Thank you.
excerpts.pre: Although there are meaningful differences between the unity among the Confederation and the unity found within a social memory complex, this repository contains anything that any member of the Confederation could desire to discover to learn. There are lessons taught among the densities and between the densities within the Confederation. But for those entities and social memory complexes of the Confederation who travel outward and attempt to serve planets, particularly those planets of the third density, they may easily call upon this repository for any type of information that might be helpful to them.
excerpts.post: And thus, any need that arises in their attempt to serve others is available in that repository. However, there are limits, of course, for it is in this service to others that we ourselves, as social memory complexes of the Confederation, learn. There must be opportunities for catalyst. And our main catalyst is in interacting with planets such as yours, and attempting to serve, and finding what distortions may result from that attempt, and continuing again and again in our attempt to serve; to rectify any distortions and to come further and further into unity with those we are serving and the One Infinite Creator.

excerpts.t: Perhaps you are not able to accept those who are causing the turmoil, and yet they are the Creator too. They are giving you a chance to grow, and by growing, we mean loving them as the Creator, looking past the third-density illusion of seeing them as separate from anyone else. This is the path that each of you travels in the third density. There will be one form of turmoil or another in your spiritual path, very, very frequently, for this is the third density with the veil of forgetting, which you must pass through and forget that all is one. By that forgetting, then, you get catalyst that helps you to grow and remember more by balancing the difficulties with your love, the anger with your love, the division with your love. Your love is the Creator’s love flowing through you, and it is a powerful love when you direct it with your free will.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I have a question. In these times of turmoil, how can we consciously balance the distortions of love and wisdom so that we progress more harmoniously upon the path of service to others?
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo and am aware of your query, my sister. You ask a question which I am sure many in this group, and many around the world who are spiritual seekers, would also ask. As you look at the turmoil in the world around you, whether it is in your neighborhood, your larger family, school, work, politics, military—at any level of existence, that turmoil can provide you catalyst that may seem difficult to process. But catalyst, in being difficult to process, requires that you change some form of your being.
excerpts.post: Is there a further query, my sister?

excerpts.t: To further hone this exercise, we would humbly suggest the practice of meditation. As you know, we speak quite frequently about this particular practice. However, we would caveat that by saying that going into the silence with the intention of finding that stillness of self that is part of every other-self, sitting in that stillness and witnessing the unity that exists that is beyond the illusion, that is beyond the separation that one may witness outside of the space of silence, taking in that warm feeling, that hug, if you will, of the Creator’s love that sees the quality, that sees the even playing ground, and that sees the unity and oneness of all things. Really, genuinely sitting in that space, experiencing, remembering it, and taking note of how that feels within the practice of meditation.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. What is the true nature of humility and how can embracing it lead to greater spiritual growth and connection with the Law of One?
excerpts.pre: It is through that exercise, that positioning of self in this space where self is loved, and all that comes in contact with and all that does not come in contact with is loved, that one may find and hone and discover that true source of humility, that part of self which says, “I am me. I am the Creator. And through that Creatorship, I am equal with all that is around me. For all that is around me is a part of me, and I a part of it.”
excerpts.post: Once the meditative practice has been at the very least embarked upon, then one may find oneself more readily available to that experience outside of the meditative practice to see the connections that exist in this seeming space of separation, and to have much grace to see oneself as equal to, perhaps, the other-self that has hurt you; perhaps to the tree that sits outside your window; perhaps to the wind that blows through your hair; or perhaps even to the most painful, stubborn bruise on the body. To see oneself as fully and truly connected to each minute speck of the illusion—again, that you witness or may not witness—and whenever you are able to feel that equality, to see that there is no greater, no lesser, but that all is a perfect and imperfect creation of the Creator manifesting itself, one may begin to drop the egoic identity, the words and concepts that one uses to separate the self from the truth that is reality.

excerpts.t: Yet most are not aware that there is the need to turn the other cheek. Most simply exist in a way of accepting or not accepting, and then getting angry or feeling loving and not knowing exactly what is happening within their life. For they are not awake, as are you, to the nature of this third-density illusion that give catalyst so that we may turn the other cheek and, at the same time, metaphorically open our hearts in love and light for whatever has caused the turmoil.
excerpts.q: I have a question. Can you expound more on what it means, and how do you turn the other cheek? Seems so important in our life to learn this practice, but so incredibly hard to do.
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo and am aware of your query, my sister. Again, we move to the area of seeing the necessity and the blessing of turning the other cheek so that you may feel more of the difficulty that is around you as a means by which you can grow more because of that difficulty. There are many layers of difficulties which will require that you be able to turn the other cheek, open the heart in love, see the larger view, move out in your mind to the level of, say, the Moon or the Sun, and see the tiny Earth spinning on its axis through space and time, knowing that that Earth, Mother Earth, has a population of beings that are all facing the same situation.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and am aware of your query, my sister. Yes, we would suggest when you feel there are any dark energies or entities or concepts that are, shall we say, taking aim upon you and your life experience, that you enter into the state of meditation. And with your heart open, send your love to these entities, surround them with your love. For they do not like to be loved. They are from an area of their own consciousness that is separate from others and wishes to control others. Send them your love with the feeling of true love for them, for they are the Creator. They are your other-selves; they just do not know that. And after you have done that, surround yourself in an armor of light and wish them well from your heart.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I’m wondering, if possible, how one can protect themselves from darker entities or negative spiritual activity when one feels subject to such thing?
excerpts.post: Is there a further query, my sister?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. The life-between-life experiences within your third density give you a chance to review the life just lived with your higher self or your guides so that if you should decide to return, you can see where there might have been refinements that you could have made in your previous life experience. Refinements that will perfect your desire to see the Creator in all and to continue moving through the densities where you become closer and closer to unification with the One Creator so that, in each higher density, there is a refinement of this review of the incarnation. But it does not require your work with higher selves as much as it does with your work with yourself, for there is no veil of forgetting in the higher densities.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. My question is about the so-called life between lives. After we leave third density, many of us believe that we go on to an experience between lives where we review our past life. And eventually, we have a chance to have another existence in third density if we want, if we can take it. So I’m wondering about the transition from third to fourth density, or from fourth to fifth, or fifth to sixth and so on. Is there an equivalent to the life between lives, when one moves between densities? And do you have a choice then to move on to another existence or go back to the same density you were in and have more challenges there?
excerpts.post: There is the overview that shows that all is one, and yet within the incarnated portion of each higher density, it is not so clear that all is one. For it seems that if that is obvious, why should you see something differently? And yet, each entity, until they reach the octave density, the eighth density, has some way of seeing itself as separate from all those around it. For they see all those around it as other-selves, as mirrors, as entities. Even though they know they are now a social memory complex and everyone has access to every experience in every incarnation that has ever been, and yet that refinement continues throughout the octave until all coalesces into the unity of the One Infinite Creator, and the entire picture begins again. The story is retold yet at another level.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. In those moments when you step off the path of love and take a detour into anger, we would suggest that you review that stepping off the path into anger in your meditation. See where you were before you stepped off the path. See what caused you to step off the path. Look at that as a portion of your spiritual journey that can be enhanced when you see that more potently within your own being, so that you can feel that anger yourself rather than feeling it for someone else.
excerpts.q: I have one last question. Occasionally, more so recently, I feel in the role of a protector. However, often times I feel I drift into anger. How do I redirect back into love more efficiently and remove myself from anger?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, my brother, and yes, you do make sense. We would suggest that each seeker of truth, such as yourself, who wishes to be of service, use whatever talents that they have. Whether it is writing a book; conducting zoom meets with large groups of people; walking down the street and seeing a child walking alone, going home and yet, no one helping the child, walking with the child and taking it home; seeing someone to the grocery store has dropped their wallet, picking it up, giving it to them—service opportunities surround you. It is a world full of opportunities to serve. Use your discrimination, use your desire, use the opportunity, whenever it presents itself to serve as you are called to serve. Every moment that you exist with the desire to serve, you serve because you are ready to serve.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a question regarding service and how one might better organize their life towards service. In that I’m wondering about how helpful or how much service to others one can accomplish, or how much one should emphasize their service to others, in terms of service to one other-self versus say, when one operates out of a sense of love in trying to have opportunities of inspiring fellow seekers, through, say, a written book, or through, say, such media where one may be approaching many people in a more scattershot methodology, if that makes sense. […]
excerpts.post: Is there a further query, my brother?

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my brother. Forming social memory complexes is the work of third density so that various portions of the One Infinite Creator may bind themselves together by the love of the One Infinite Creator, and see the Creator and everyone around them. So that they may help the Creator to know Itself in a more advanced form, what you call, a social memory complex.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. How important is it to form positively oriented social memory complexes at this time on the earth? And why is it, if so, why is it important?
excerpts.post: And we would suggest at this time that there is a social memory complex forming upon your planet, formed of seekers such as gathered here today. All over the planet, there are these types of seekers that are beginning the foundation stones, shall we say, of the fourth density of love and understanding and will move forward as individuals when they drop their bodies and walk into the light of the fourth density.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of your query, my sister. This is the work of your third-density illusion. For you have what many call a kind of intellectual knowledge that could be seen at your level of existence as a wisdom, and yet it has that which lacks wisdom, and that is the limits of your knowledge. For the intellect is confined to the third-density illusion. So once you are able to move your heart in an open-hearted way that sees all as the Creator in whatever experience you are having, whatever experience you hope to have, this open heart leads you to the fifth-density of light, which is the wisdom density that sees beyond all boundaries of the third-density illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have a question. How can we consciously balance love and wisdom to progress more harmoniously on the path of service to others?
excerpts.post: And then in your meditation, look at whatever service you wish to offer, [including] service in general, and ask that the Creator’s love flow through your heart, and the Creator’s wisdom flow through your heart and become joined in equal nature in that effort that you are making to be of service to others.

excerpts.t: This awareness is important to hold because prayer and meditation and contemplation are not mechanical acts or technical procedures—they are expressions of faith. Faith is not the straw to which one clings as an act of hopelessness. Faith is not desperation, though desperation, indeed, may precipitate and inspire a true act of faith.
excerpts.q: Okay, thank you. I figured that was the case. I have a question. I’d like to continue exploring your focus of helping to alleviate the disharmony of war and bellicosity. The Confederation has affirmed, in various ways, the power of prayer and meditation in aiding peace on our planet. Often, seekers feel helpless in the face of such large forces that lead us to war and violence, and prayer and meditation seem to be the only way to help. Can you elaborate on exactly how praying and meditating for peace helps metaphysically? […]
excerpts.pre: Fortunately for those who have encountered a more mature philosophy, and we would count the Law of One among those bodies of work, one can be bolstered in the awareness, on multiple levels, that there are countless beings in the unseen realm who ache to be of service in any manner available to them. Those who wait on the other end of the telephone, shall we say, for it to ring that they may be given permission and opportunity to jump forward and lend their strength, their energy, their talent, and a very powerful focus and portal through which the Creator Itself may move, that the situation or person or group may receive the loving guidance of eternity.
excerpts.post: Faith starts out as positive belief but becomes a surety, a knowing beyond intellectual knowledge, a transcendence of the rational mind and the world system whereby the entity has leapt into the air, into nothing, and rests not upon a structure of logical thought or scientific theory, but in that eternity which is forever beyond space and time, which was before space and time, which is one’s true nature.

excerpts.t: This is not a faith which grants one the ability to order the universe, or correct its wrongs or distortions, but to see to the true situation behind and beneath the mirage of the illusion of separation. And in this clear seeing, there is a fundamental basis of acceptance, of love and acceptance. This includes love and acceptance in the face of all which transpires on the surface of your planet in the way of harm and war and disharmony. There is a peaceful acceptance of the Creator manifesting Itself in the light and the dark.
excerpts.q: Okay, thank you. I figured that was the case. I have a question. I’d like to continue exploring your focus of helping to alleviate the disharmony of war and bellicosity. The Confederation has affirmed, in various ways, the power of prayer and meditation in aiding peace on our planet. Often, seekers feel helpless in the face of such large forces that lead us to war and violence, and prayer and meditation seem to be the only way to help. Can you elaborate on exactly how praying and meditating for peace helps metaphysically? […]
excerpts.pre: Faith is the bridge to this reality, your deeper nature. And through this bridge or portal or doorway, one who is upon the positive path is more centered in their own power.
excerpts.post: And in this seeing, there is the opportunity to respond. And there is the opportunity to bring this vision to a moment where the teeth are gnashing and the entities are twisted and distorted and locked within a dream, perhaps a dark dream of retribution, of hatred, of division, and so forth.

excerpts.t: For our specialty, as you may say, has been through our evolution through the fourth density of attempting to help groups such as this on third-density planets channel in one way or another, not necessarily of the vocal variety but to aid the perspective shift that comes along with channeling, to help mind/body/spirit complexes within the veiled third density adopt greater perspectives to open their personalities up to different ways of expression and being.
excerpts.q: I love the bit about love being the doorway and primary factor. [In response to Tovo’s prompt:] Not on those questions. Let’s set aside this government business and focus on you for a moment. Tovo, can you share something about your backstory or your density of origin, if you have a specialty, as it were, and so on?
excerpts.pre: We are excited to share with you that we find ourselves in a sort of new journey, you may say. Our harvest into the fifth density, as we experience it, is somewhat recent, and our experience of working with groups like this has shifted in this recent past, you may say—recent from our perspective, that is; which is quite a longer perspective than you have as an incarnate third-density being on planet Earth. However, this is still very new to us.
excerpts.post: And as we have undertaken this journey and responded to a call of this group for new experiences of channeling, we are able to then practice within our new landscape of the fifth density. We are able to find a new method of sharing this service that we have explored through our fourth density, and [to then] attempt to offer it through this group as you experience the vocal channeling.

excerpts.t: Why should it only be something that occurs in one’s mind? Why not have it be an expression outside of oneself, one that is not stifled, one that is as unbounded as the creation about you, one that transcends even that which one can see? When one can see one’s self as worthy of that, when one can see oneself as the expression of the Creator and the creation, then one can also allow oneself to be creativity itself, to be the magician working one’s magic. And though in certain situations one’s surroundings are challenging, the magician may work their creative magic to see beyond this failed illusion. To part the curtain, if you will, and see the magic, the beauty, the wonder, the imperfect perfection, and to feel the love that drives all that is around you.
excerpts.q: After one is finished channeling, there’s often a sense of residue of things unexplored, nuances or aspects that didn’t get conveyed. And I was thinking about our spiritual seeker and friend and wanderer in war-torn, or maybe not war-torn, but conflict-heavy area of Iran. He shared this beautiful story of, as bombs are falling, how his young daughter and her friend were making games, and there was still joy in their home as there was violence around them, and so forth. So my question is about the capacity and power of creativity even in dire or difficult circumstances, and how creativity, and maybe even joy, might have the capacity to transform situations.
excerpts.pre: Think you upon the ability of the Creator—and by Creator we mean capital “C” Creator. It is in the Creator’s name, the ability to create. And if you are, in essence, a part of that Creator, are you not also creative? Is that not also innate in your beingness? Think not about how that beingness may express itself, what it may look like. The Creator has no bounds. The creation has no bounds. Why should your creativity have bounds?
excerpts.post: We realize that may not take off the full sting or discomfort that comes with this experience in which you have chosen to incarnate within, for those moments of discomfort are also valid. Your experiences are valid, and the lessons learned from them are powerful.

excerpts.t: But what this power, love, and wisdom—this infinite energy within—can do is to expand the container of consciousness within which these challenging catalysts occur in the self so that the flash of anger and hatred that may wish to do harm to the harm-giver, or the moment of despair, or the overcoming with tears in the witness of loss, personal or otherwise, may be held within the self with respect and honor in a heart of love. Love for that which one is experiencing, love for others in clear-seeing of the ignorance with which others commit their harm.
excerpts.q: Hi Q’uo, thank you for being with us. Unconditional love and gratitude to you. I was wondering if you could offer any words of comfort or insight to those of our brothers and sisters who find themselves in the midst of intense catalyst such as those currently living in the company of war, and are seeing up close and personal the deaths of neighbors and sometimes friends and family as they struggle to avoid such violence themselves. Could you offer any words of comfort or insight to them please? Thank you.
excerpts.pre: The strength and resilience to process and honor the emotions one may be experiencing, this tapping of the inner light and awareness of the inner light, is not the banishment of the, shall we say, human dimension of form and identity—the entity does not become immune to tears and pain of self or others.
excerpts.post: In awakening from the dream in gradation of degrees, one comes more clearly into an awareness of just how unconscious and asleep many are within the illusion. Not in a judgmental sense, not with a sense of superiority or denigration, but with a sacred respect for the game that the One Infinite Creator Itself is playing of forgetting—with great respect for the entities upon their journey in the realization that these other-selves, asleep though they may be, forever and always have their hands upon the wheel and their foot at the ready for the brakes or the accelerator of awakening.

excerpts.t: The Creator as the Creator in its ultimate, final, and non-dual sense, cannot enter the war-torn country and separate the warring factions and readjust the scales of justice. Nor can those of your higher-density friends. The work done in third density is through the entities of third density. You are each, our friends, vessels through which the Creator may do Its work. The more open your hearts, the more activated and balanced your energy system, the more the Creator can pluck harmony and make music with the instrument that you are in simple and humble and everyday ways in the moment, the more that you yourself are freed to respond to the moment, not with fear or desire for retribution, but with love.
excerpts.q: Hi Q’uo, thank you for being with us. Unconditional love and gratitude to you. I was wondering if you could offer any words of comfort or insight to those of our brothers and sisters who find themselves in the midst of intense catalyst such as those currently living in the company of war, and are seeing up close and personal the deaths of neighbors and sometimes friends and family as they struggle to avoid such violence themselves. Could you offer any words of comfort or insight to them please? Thank you.
excerpts.pre: The self can be this message, not by any particular talent or act of volition, but by a radiation of their own realization of oneness with the Creator—by their own inner work, which we are encouraging all entities, regardless of circumstance, to do. As the entity seeks, they become that which they seek.
excerpts.post: In closing this, as this instrument tugs at us, lengthy response, we would offer sincere empathy and sympathy to those who suffer upon your plane, including and especially those identified in the question. What you, our brothers and sisters in these circumstances, undergo is among the, shall we say, toughest it will ever get in this octave of evolution, so far as we can speak. This is the crucible. This is the test. This is, as those of Ra have said, where “the statue is forged in the fire.” Every capacity of your being will be tested and pushed and pulled and stretched to its max. That you are here is not by accident. That you are here means that there is opportunity, even in this sometimes, in some circumstances, unspeakable cruelty. That you stand where you stand is not a function of cruel fate or malfunction of the system.

excerpts.t: But to turn more to the heart of your query, it is indeed an ever present dynamic of the third density, for even those entities who may exist within that peaceful day that we referred to earlier, will not exist within that peace forever. Even though they may never become aware of the suffering elsewhere, suffering will visit them in one way or another. It is impossible within your density for most seekers to avoid suffering. It is impossible to relieve yourself of this suffering, for indeed, it is the purpose of your density to experience the suffering in one way or another, to allow the Creator in which there is no suffering, to trick Itself into believing that such suffering is real, that such suffering does take place in some form of reality.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. The news in our world is often of a disharmonious or upsetting or even heartbreaking nature. So this question is about the relationship of the seeker to news. Too much of it, and we risk despair or depression or disempowerment. Too little of it, and we become isolated and disconnected in a bubble of our own private world from the suffering of others. Can you speak to how the spiritual seeker may navigate this balance, please?
excerpts.pre: We are speaking more to the technology itself and how it is utilized, and not necessarily to the heart of your question, that is, how a seeker may find some sense of balance and service when such an onslaught of information and awareness of suffering is available every moment of every day. The technology—and not just what you would call digital technology, but social technology—at play is important to examine within this dynamic. There are many, many influences upon how you receive information, and this is important in learning how to cope with or process such information.
excerpts.post: And so the Creator decides to hide from Itself and allow Itself to inflict suffering upon Itself. This may seem, from a certain perspective, a type of sick game. However, it is important to remember the primal distortion of the Creator, and that is free will; that, in order to genuinely experience any experience, in order to genuinely hide from Itself, it must allow the most far reaches of separation to be manifest within the creation—Its aspects cast out into the creation are imbued with the free will primal to its beingness, primal to the very creation of its creation. And with that free will, each seeker, each entity, may choose to inflict suffering upon another, or to attempt to alleviate that suffering, or to take that suffering within the self. There are many ways to relate to this dynamic.

excerpts.t: I am Q’uo, and we feel that we have a query, that you might like to know why this is necessary and how it is helpful. What we would say is that you must remember that in the third density you live in an illusion. It is the illusion created by the veil of forgetting. If you were not in the third density and were beyond that veil of forgetting, you would look back and see all of the suffering was appropriate. The Creator is knowing Itself. And when all are beyond the veil of forgetting, we will continue to move forward through the higher densities where there is no veil, there is no feeling of suffering, there is more and more the feeling and the knowing and the being of the Creator in oneself and in all things.
excerpts.q: I’m not sure how to ask this, but I just wish the Creator could know Itself without such suffering and pain and destruction.
excerpts.post: Is there a further query, my brother?

excerpts.t: But if any entity of the third density feels it has not done what it wished to do, it has as many incarnations as necessary to fulfill that desire. For in truth, there is nothing but the Creator learning from Itself through every portion of Itself. There is no way that the Creator is ever failed by anyone in what they do. Each portion of the Creator, however, can move more fully and freely into the light and love of the Creator as its ultimate path, by taking as many incarnations as possible to decide how to move back to the Creator—in the positive way of serving others and in the negative way of serving self—until, of course, the early sixth density when all must be seen as the Creator.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I’ve been practicing seeing all beings as the Creator. I have enjoyed seeing the birds and trees and other parts of nature on our property as parts of the Creator. Yesterday, I was watching the birds, and suddenly a hawk swooped down out of nowhere and tried to snatch one of the birds. It got me thinking about death and killing and all the negative things that happen in the midst of this beautiful nature we have. Bombing and war, too. How are these events a reflection of the Creator?
excerpts.pre: If they see that they have perhaps wandered from the course they chose prior to the incarnation, then they will very likely attempt another incarnation to relearn this lesson that hasn’t been fulfilled, and the Creator will know what it is like to recommit oneself to doing better instead of failing. There is no way that any action, thought, or word, spoken in any way—in a barbarous way, in a loving way, in a confused way, in a humorous way—can do anything but give the Creator information about Itself. There is no way anyone can fail at any time to help the Creator to know Itself.

excerpts.t: You ask about different applications of sound healing in the service to others, including the intuitive playing as you have described, and the other more specific frequency, asking what the impact and consequences and ultimate help these different modalities may be. We may counsel you, our brother, that the healer—whatever may be their particular modality, whether they are the allopathic or naturopathic or psychological or music-making type of healer—has a variety of tools in their tool belt, shall we say. Part of the great art of serving as catalyst, that is, serving as one who offers the healing catalyst, is in practicing the faculty of empathy and presence such that one may intuit the request for service from the other-self or other-selves and respond accordingly.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a query. Thank you for being here in this moment we call now. It is my greatest excitement to share our dialog with you. My question pertains to the facilitation of vibration with an instrument, specifically what we call sound healing. Could we touch on individual mind/body/spirit basis, and also broaden our stroke to planetary alignment, or what we call good work? This is a path of service to others that brings me much joy. Are there any specific time signatures, such as writing in a Fibonacci sequence, that are more advantageous than, say, playing intuitively with one’s intention focused on, say, cellular realignment?
excerpts.pre: We are those as Q’uo, and we thank you for the gift of your heart invested into this question, and the energy with which you bring to your question and your desire to be of service, our brother. We must first offer an apology that while we may and will do our utmost to lend insight to your question, there is some specialized knowledge that we do not find within this instrument’s personal experience and memory banks that makes communication on some of this point limited. We therefore have only the recourse of a more broader response to your question.
excerpts.post: One may, through their practice of healing—or of simply making music that inspires and brings joy and activates the soul through this practice of experimentation and discipline—learn which modalities tend to have which effects which…

excerpts.t: Music is a very powerful way to give voice to this love that encompasses all things, music and sound generally. For the being has rational, logical, analytical, and language-based faculties and modes. And this, in the integrated being, is woven into the larger whole. But the being expands far beyond the limitations of the rational mind and the logic-bound mind, and music and sound on a very primal level may speak to these other and deeper and wider aspects of beingness.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I have a query. Thank you for being here in this moment we call now. It is my greatest excitement to share our dialog with you. My question pertains to the facilitation of vibration with an instrument, specifically what we call sound healing. Could we touch on individual mind/body/spirit basis, and also broaden our stroke to planetary alignment, or what we call good work? This is a path of service to others that brings me much joy. Are there any specific time signatures, such as writing in a Fibonacci sequence, that are more advantageous than, say, playing intuitively with one’s intention focused on, say, cellular realignment?
excerpts.pre: It is that quality of love and your beingness itself that becomes a transmission to help light the way for others, to help remind them of their own innate healing capacity, or their own innate power, or their own inherent freedom from the struggles which seem to bind them.
excerpts.post: We are those of Q’uo and would ask if there is a follow up to this question?

excerpts.t: The opportunity may be presented again to deal with whatever catalyst it was, whether it is anger, confusion, a lack of any thought concerning the problem, then the condition will worsen. And then, hopefully, the entity experiencing whatever the sickness is, cancer of whatever part of the body, will then go to a doctor, such as you perhaps. They can see that there are more ways of dealing with diseases than with medicine, and perhaps you or anyone else that can provide this service can be a mirror to the one suffering the disease and can give advice that speaks to the soul of the one experiencing the disease by sharing their own knowledge of others who have had these diseases and how they dealt with them.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, I’m writing the second edition of my Vital Strategies in Cancer book and have patients in great need who come to see me with cancer. What insights can you share for me in terms of guiding those patients? What insights in terms of making the book a dynamic book that will attract the readers that need to find that information? I appreciate your thoughts.

excerpts.t: This seeming connection is due to the fact that, for an entity to polarize service to self, there is a need to master, you may say, the energies of these lower energy centers towards a certain end. There is a need, through a great strength of will, to avoid and close off the self from that influence of the green ray that would be experienced within the heart chakra of the entity, and instead bolster the energies of the lower energy centers absent of this green ray influence.
excerpts.q: Yeah, I didn’t expect that there was any riddle there or hidden meaning, but rather just that the syntax got messed up in transmission, but it’s only a guess. Yes, in my personal opinion, there seems to be widespread confusion regarding differentiating behaviors that exhibit as service to self and those that exhibit as service to others, even and especially among those awakening to spiritual reality. Not that we can easily know the heart of an other-self and what their ultimate polarity may be, much less what the polarized intention of any given action is. […]
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo, and we believe we grasp the heart of your query. We find the identification of energies with seeming service-to-self tendencies to be quite congruent with the idea that fourth-density energies coming to your planet cause a regression, particularly when framed as a regression into the lower energy centers.
excerpts.post: The behaviors that are indicative of these patterns present within the orange and yellow ray chakras in particular may look almost identical to the behaviors of a polarizing service-to-self entity, because they exist within the same realm of so-called development within the self. They are of the same energy, you may say.

excerpts.t: This is the aspect of the quote that we feel is most important: that the wanderer, that soul from a higher density who has already experienced third density, may look upon the incarnational plan to travel back and wander into third density with some strong desire to serve. And this desire to serve can be overpowering, even overwhelming, for this higher-density entity [generating] the motivation to then incarnate, and attempt to serve a planetary population such as yours that has found itself swirling, you may say, within a certain cycle of regression and catalyst presented by that regression. This can create a very powerful pull. And as the wanderer takes upon it the full forgetting of the third density, it is not necessarily equipped with the perspective that allowed it to make the decision to incarnate, the perspective that would then encourage it to focus its efforts upon service, one-pointedly.
excerpts.q: There are more questions, Q’uo. First, a quick housekeeping note, there will just be two channels today it seems, so you can divide up your time accordingly. Kind of related to this subject, it’s complex, apologies. In #12.28, Ra is talking about the purity of mind and the foolhardiness/bravery necessary for the higher-density soul to wander to this planet. Then Ra adds this seemingly garbled statement: The challenge/danger of the wanderer is that it will forget its mission, become karmically involved, and thus be swept into the maelstrom from which it had incarnated to aid the destruction. […]
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of the query, my brother. We may speak and elaborate more upon this particular passage, with the caveat that we are working with an instrument that has experienced much contemplation and engaged in much discourse around this, as you have worded it, garbled quotation. Indeed, we would find that the words used in this passage are confusing and inadequate, and we may not speak necessarily to their original intention, but rather can reflect upon them as you have presented them with a focus upon the notion of a wanderer incarnating and being swept away, you may say, into a maelstrom.
excerpts.post: Rather, the wanderer must awaken to its nature within the incarnation, and it is often forced—we correct this instrument—forgotten, in a sense, by the higher-density entity, just how powerful this so-called maelstrom can be. And so we find your description of the maelstrom to be quite apt, in that there is a circular nature, a swirling that becomes disorienting.

excerpts.t: This will require more and more catalyst of greater and greater degrees, for it must increase in its intensity to draw the attention of the individual and to break through, you may say, to the hardened protection around the heart that has been built by the energies of the orange and yellow rays. But this catalyst can work, and if your planetary population were not able to grasp it and utilize it, then it would not be present. The potential of your planetary population is what manifests the degree of this catalyst.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you, Q’uo. It’s good to be with you. I think these might be the last of my world-focused questions for a bit. I find myself of two minds at times. My spiritual heart senses the movement toward the fourth density of love and understanding; and I see so much evidence of the global awakening increasing, as it has been for decades. But my more news-oriented, rational mind reads the headlines and sees a planet in peril, whether through ecological degradation, proliferation of nuclear weapons, or return to a political philosophy of might makes right, the increasing gap in wealth inequality and so on. […]
excerpts.pre: We witness the greatest probability/possibility unfolding that the work done by many individuals is succeeding. [There may be] much chaos and turbulence to unfold and much catalyst to be visited upon your planetary population. But [due to this work], this catalyst then has the possibility of succeeding in its mission, which is to cause you as a planetary population to turn together towards the heart.
excerpts.post: Is there a follow up to this query, my brother?

excerpts.t: But faith, as we intend it, is not a belief in a set of ideas. Faith is not even necessarily belief of, or in, that known to you as the Law of One text. Instead, faith is that which connects you—you being this illusory, separate entity of mind, body, and spirit—to your true nature in and as the One. This faith, as we have conveyed before, expresses itself in the being, in the awareness, and in the incontrovertible surety that all is well. Whether it be life or death, good times or difficult times.
excerpts.q: Yeah, thank you, Q’uo. This query I’ve been trying to form as you’ve been talking, so I apologize if it’s not fully formed. But within that response, you recognized faith with terms such as formless, absent of resistance, totally free, unthinking. You said that somebody in faith is relieved from the constraints and strictures of reality, and that through faith, one can come into contact with what is actually happening. And as you were talking, I have a question in my mind that I’ve had for a long time, and that is that those of Ra identified a congruency between faith and intelligent infinity. […]
excerpts.pre: As you know, our brother, there are no words or concepts or physics for the infinite. But there are multiple inroads for the thinking mind to, shall we say, reach and seek and contemplate. And this, we find, is one such helpful inquiry, for often your peoples have associated this word faith as belief without evidence, as the doctrine and the dogma which an ecclesiastical class expects the laity to accept uncritically. And faith then becomes a creed; and that, in your own lexicon, is indeed one variation in the meaning of that term.
excerpts.post: It is not that one believes all is well as a principle or precept, though that can indeed be a powerful reprogramming affirmation or mantra. Rather, it is that faith clarifies any seeming landscape to reveal that all is indeed well against the backdrop of infinity, for nothing is ever lost. Nothing was ever created. Therefore nothing ever can be destroyed.

excerpts.t: Is it clearer, or, in your logical terms, more effective to see and analyze and study the shadows shaking upon the surface? Or to step out from that cave and see the light source which was creating their shadows? To recognize that that light source is within the self and is ultimately the self. This is the same light source that underlies any moment in any incarnation within third density, and every moment of any place the entity’s feet may take them through the multi-dimensional journey of the birth and death of densities and octaves and entities and places. To such an entity who has learned to abide in faith, they are free and liberated from the constraints and strictures of the illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo, I have some queries as these are also somewhat complex, so thank you for bearing with me. The first one is inspired by something that our friends of Halos said in our last session, so I’ll read you the quote. Halos said: “Faith starts out as positive belief, but becomes a surety, a knowing beyond intellectual knowledge, a transcendence of the rational mind and the world system whereby the entity has leapt into the air into nothing and rests upon not a structure of logical thought or scientific theory, but in that eternity which is forever beyond space and time, which has before, which was before space and time, and which is one’s true nature. […]
excerpts.pre: And it may seem to the reader that to look upon the moment with faithful eyes is to become, shall we pejoratively say, dumb: to turn off the intelligence, to become unthinking. But we may say that it is only through faith that truth may flow into and through the self. It is only through faith that one may make contact with what is actually happening in any given moment.
excerpts.post: This is not to say that they are impervious to harm or bodily destruction. But rather that they have found a true end to suffering and may move about freely in single-pointedness, in the desire, or rather, in the beingness of pure radiance which radiates regardless of the circumstance or the mistreatment or the cruelty on display. Which is beyond the basic and necessary maintenance of the body and the mind and the lower chakras as, through discipline, will and faith become crystallized, that the Creator may operate through this entity who believed, for a time, that it was separate. And through devotion and inquiry and faith, surrender the entire separate identity that it had made from an illusory position, merging once more into that infinite awareness from which it never separated.

excerpts.t: The beauty of the creation and the game of manyness is that the Creator, you, may seem to have this experience; may seem to look back upon yourself as infinity, identified with a particular focal point of form, and thus relate to and behold and glory in infinity. And in this glory, radiate a sense of beauty and awe and thanksgiving.
excerpts.q: Yeah, thank you, Q’uo. This query I’ve been trying to form as you’ve been talking, so I apologize if it’s not fully formed. But within that response, you recognized faith with terms such as formless, absent of resistance, totally free, unthinking. You said that somebody in faith is relieved from the constraints and strictures of reality, and that through faith, one can come into contact with what is actually happening. And as you were talking, I have a question in my mind that I’ve had for a long time, and that is that those of Ra identified a congruency between faith and intelligent infinity. […]

excerpts.t: Indeed, it is true that challenge and difficulty is fodder for growth for the mind/body/spirit complex, and for your planet as a whole being. But we would ask, if you have within your direct perception an entity suffering, and the impulse you feel is to relieve that suffering, and it is within your means to do so, would you feel called to immediately relieve the entities suffering? And if so, where does this call come from? Is it your personal will that you wish to see their suffering end, or is it the will of the Creator that moves you, that brings you compassion, and allows you to move your mind/body/spirit complex in order that the other entity may cease its suffering?
excerpts.q: Yes, I have a question. Thank you, Q’uo, for your willingness to serve the One Infinite Creator. My question is regarding a prayer that a friend of mine repeats about world peace. And what I run up against is having experienced so much growth as a result of a lack of personal peace and suffering. My thought is, is that if I think I know what’s best for the world, that it all should be a world of peace. And that I’m praying for that, that somehow I’m playing like God, that I know better. […]
excerpts.pre: It is a question of wisdom that you have posed, whether it is best to allow the world to exist in a state of difficulty and chaos and pain and confusion so that it may serve as an environment for other seekers to experience similar catalyst posed by such difficulty. We cannot offer a prescription, you may say, to how to orient to this question, but we can somewhat speak around it to allow perhaps a new perspective into your own contemplations as you attempt to grapple with this query.
excerpts.post: This is not a question that we wish to answer for you, but wish to pose to you, to bring into your meditations, to understand where the impulse of love and service within your heart comes from, and how you may express it and allow it to manifest in any given situation.

excerpts.t: So if you can set your intention to share whatever you share, to teach them to listen on the basis of your love, the Creator’s love flowing through you, then you will be communicating with the Creator within each child, whether it is kindergarten, grade school, junior high. The more this can be done at an earlier age, the more the love of the Creator becomes a foundation for the child to do everything the child will ever do, and most of what children do is listen and then repeat what they’ve heard and to amplify it with that love that you have given them.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo, for listening to us. I’m tasked with teaching young children new ways to listen, and I’m just seeking any wisdom or perspective you might have on teaching children in elementary and intermediate school about ways to listen better.
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo, and we are aware of your query, my sister. Ah, the young child, so willing to absorb information, so willing to listen if they are spoken to from your heart. They are new to this world in most cases. And as time goes on, they grow according to how people who have an open heart, like you, have shared the love of the Creator coming through your heart to the children that you’re teaching to listen. For they are still closer to the Creator than they will be as time goes on, just as a natural process of being born into the third-density illusion and moving forward in whatever way they are taught or feel.
excerpts.post: Is there a further query, my sister?

excerpts.t: And though they are illusory, they still exist. The necessity of the will to pierce this illusion still exists. It is in this necessity, and the expression of your will as worship of the One Infinite Creator, that allows you to more fully embody this connection; to dissolve more and more of this illusion so that you may, as you walk the veiled path within the third density, be more innate in your connection with the One Infinite Creator. You may walk in faith, allowing this illusory distance between the self and the Creator to have less of an influence, so that your own personal will may be in alignment with that of the One Infinite Creator.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I am hoping you can expand on the idea of worship in relation to the One Infinite Creator. I often find that when I think about that word, my mind goes to some Old Testament entity baggage with the idea of worship, and I wonder if you could expand on it beyond that?
excerpts.pre: And in taking the posture of worship towards the One Infinite Creator, one may set aside those aspects of personal beingness—what we have called the personality shell, or even aspects of ego—that have been built up and have allowed you to move about your third density in certain ways, but perhaps do not serve you on your spiritual journey. In setting these things aside through worship, through the desire to come into contact with intelligent infinity with the One Infinite Creator, with the infinite mystery of the universe, one can find this power more readily, not just outside of the self, but within the self, and realize that these distinctions of inner and outer are illusory.
excerpts.post: This concept of worship comes from this necessity of the third-density self to lose the self, to forget this connection, and to then again seek that connection. It [can be] useful to feel small, and sometimes it is useful to feel as though the universe expands infinitely beyond the self, because this puts one in an orientation of attempting to seek the greatness of the One Infinite Creator. But a successful worship, as we would identify it, is one which does not emphasize the smallness or the insignificance, but rather one which seeks to dive so far deep into that smallness that one comes out the other side in recognition that one may be both infinitely small and infinitely large, and at one with the One Infinite Creator.

excerpts.t: Trust yourself, trust your heart, trust the pureness of the love you feel whenever you meditate upon it, and know that you are, by your very nature, and by asking this question, setting a pure intention towards making big decisions in your life with compassion, with a mind towards service. Have faith in your ability and give yourself much grace, much patience.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. When there are decisions to be made in life, how do you recognize which one is the most full of love, contains the best and highest good? How do you recognize that?
excerpts.pre: Now we understand that there will be times when one undertakes this practice and the path forward is a little murky, or perhaps the seeker is presented with two paths. My friend, that is when full trust in yourself and believing, in one’s core, that all is well will be of great aid. There will be missteps. There will be times when decisions are challenging to make, when everything may go right (and we use right in a subjective way), and times when it feels like everything has gone to dirt. My friends, you cannot make a mistake. You can only learn from these things.
excerpts.post: Sometimes decisions or changes in life require more than just a single meditation or a single space of contemplation. Perhaps it takes many; perhaps it comes out of nowhere and it hits you like a ton of bricks, you may say, and you realize what is at the core is this central feeling within you, that you are worthy, that you are full of love and made by love, and that you invest love in this path.

excerpts.t: But love itself is never contained to an illusory past or a relationship that is no more, be it within or between entities of any densities. Once two, shall we say, points within the illusion make that connection such that love blossoms within their hearts and they feel love come alive in their shared presence and shared experience, that love is forever available so long as the entity does not put any block in the way, or armor the self against the loss of that which was held to be dear and lose themselves in grief or denial or anger. We do not say that these and associated emotions ought to be repressed or denied. It is appropriate and healthy to experience these emotions and the consequences of loss from the perspective of the third-density entity within the illusion.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I was curious if you could give guidance on communicating or communing with our second-density loved ones who have left the physical and are in the inner planes?
excerpts.pre: But it is the essence of that connection which can be viewed through these artifacts of your time together that you may continue this journey of connection with this other expression, this other-self expression of the Creator. Love is not bound to time [but] is seemingly, magically experienced through the journey of time. And through such a journey of space and time, one may learn to open the heart more widely with less condition, more universally, and upon a conscious level, experience that love which has made all things, from a new vantage point, a deeper perspective, a more embodied experience. This, the construct of time and space, grants all of us the opportunity upon an upward-spiraling journey of learning; this deepening our experience and understanding of love.
excerpts.post: Rather, it is that a grip upon grief, or any perspective which springs from a separation-based mindset of a finite world, can preclude from one’s vision the deeper reality which transcends the construct of space and time; wherein that connection once made remains alive and of the present moment forever and ever.

excerpts.t: With that knowledge, one cannot fail, so long as one is always pointing the steering wheel in the direction of love. How one may do that is to take oneself into that sanctum of silence and to focus on love, be that an image, a person, an idea, anything which [re]sounds within your being of love, which brings that emotion to the forefront of your heart and your mind. When focusing upon that element, you may begin to ask [of] yourself, “I wish to move forward and make a decision from this place I am feeling in this moment,” and then allow oneself to be enveloped by that love with an open mind and an open ear. It is in that silent, loving place where one is overtaken by the things which bring one joy that one may begin to hear the whispers, or the nudges, or the visions which allow oneself to see a path forward.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. When there are decisions to be made in life, how do you recognize which one is the most full of love, contains the best and highest good? How do you recognize that?
excerpts.pre: By that, we do not mean meditation is the only way of coming about that. We simply mean that finding yourself in a challenging situation and desiring to know what is the highest and best requires the practice and honing of one’s intuition. It requires the trust in one’s ability to know oneself, to accept oneself, and to see oneself as perfectly imperfect—to know that there will be mistakes and that that is part of the lesson.

excerpts.t: As you may know, the body, if it comes into contact with an external source that triggers pain, will reflexively pull away from that source. However, it gets complex and complicated when this biological basis is intertwined with the mind complex, the storytelling complex, the identity-making complex, which finds meaning in pain, and the layers of pain that the mind creates, which one may call suffering of an emotional or a mental nature, such that this pain can be amplified, and this mind—informed by that basic, rudimentary impulse to run away from pain—can make a habit of this in one’s mental patterns such that it itself is, shall we say, carved into the neural pathways of the brain and the nervous system; that it becomes habituated and can be transposed onto those sources of pain which are purely of an emotional and non-physical nature, i.e., the mistreatment or the abuse, perceived or actual, from an other-self or a situation which one finds undesirable and to be avoided.
excerpts.q: I’ve got one, if nobody else has one. Q’uo, I’ve been wondering about the natural tendency of people to avoid suffering and avoid difficulty, and in the light of the fact that a lot of our spiritual growth comes through suffering and difficulty, and I’m primarily curious right now about the sort of biological mechanisms that have trained us to avoid pain, avoid discomfort, and avoid suffering. Ra said that our Logos has designed certain aspects of our biological beingness to accentuate our spiritual path. So I’m wondering if that is true of the natural evolution that caused us to avoid pain and avoid suffering? […]
excerpts.pre: And, indeed, there is a biological recoiling from the experience of pain. For it is an important signal or point of instruction for the second-density entity that tells them about their environment and what to be avoided, if we may speak simplistically. And to a degree, this does carry over into the third-density experience as the body itself and one’s neurology reacts to move the self away from pain.
excerpts.post: This biological basis can influence and inform and help to contribute to these habituated responses. But we would say, while each situation and entity is unique, generally speaking, this biological basis is not necessarily causal. Rather, we would suggest that the responsibility exists principally within the mind complex and its use, skillful or otherwise, conscious or unconscious, of the will and its capacity and intention to look at, and face, and process one’s catalyst.

excerpts.t: A mind or entity who has not made, or done much work to make, their catalyst and their thinking and their beingness conscious will largely live a life unconsciously, reacting to catalyst and the body’s proclivity to avoid pain unconsciously. And the mind’s proclivity to carry that forward will mutually energize one another and reinforce one another such that catalysts of a mental and emotional nature may show up in the body—that is, the body may react to that catalyst of a mental nature, which is not being processed.
excerpts.q: I’ve got one, if nobody else has one. Q’uo, I’ve been wondering about the natural tendency of people to avoid suffering and avoid difficulty, and in the light of the fact that a lot of our spiritual growth comes through suffering and difficulty, and I’m primarily curious right now about the sort of biological mechanisms that have trained us to avoid pain, avoid discomfort, and avoid suffering. Ra said that our Logos has designed certain aspects of our biological beingness to accentuate our spiritual path. So I’m wondering if that is true of the natural evolution that caused us to avoid pain and avoid suffering? […]
excerpts.post: Such a less-than-conscious being is at risk of victimhood, of disempowering the self’s ability to use catalyst [such] that they live within this, as the one known as Eckhart Tolle has described, pain body—activating it, energizing it, and projecting that pain outwards in lack of self-responsibility onto others.

excerpts.t: It may sound trite or cliche to counsel one to follow their heart. But this, we assure you, is not a superficial suggestion. It takes work in consciousness, through the exercise of will and faith, and particularly the ability to consciously listen to silence and stillness, to enter one’s own heart, to clear out one’s energy field through practices of loving acceptance and forgiveness, to free the heart of self judgment and judgment of others.
excerpts.q: I have a question, Q’uo. So the question is, it’s about our place in this world and how we contribute and be of service to others. How do we know if we are contributing and being of service? It is not my question. It is my friend’s question. So I will try to translate as best as I can. How do we… it is the goal to… in being of service, is it to create peace and harmony? Is that the indicator that we are in our right place and being of service, or is that a limited perception? Is there, the question is, how do we know if we are properly, I mean, being of service? Is there another indicator? How do we, how do we know?
excerpts.pre: In this seeking to know how one may tell if they are in the right place making the right choices, we can only and ever counsel you, our brother and all our friends of third density, to learn to go within, for the ultimate authority and source of knowing exists forever and always within your own heart.
excerpts.post: It takes this work to enter into the depths of one’s own heart, which is the key to the portal to the One Creator which awaits there in the sacred innermost portion of one’s own heart of being always and right now. There are only the layers of masks and personas and distorted ideas about who the self is that must be lovingly understood and forgiven and, if not discarded altogether, then made transparent such that the self can rest strongly and humbly in the center of their own being and trust that intuition, that inspiration that moves through the silence, to the conscious mind.

excerpts.t: Allowing individuals to exist within their body without pain is indeed a noble goal. However, we can say that, from our perspective—that is, [one] privileged to be removed from the grappling hooks of such pain and such stories around pain—that the pain itself does indeed have a divine purpose. That this pain is not a punishment or a random difficulty inflicted upon you as a peoples to experience and to try to eliminate without question. We do understand and believe it is a noble service to attempt to eliminate pain, however, as we witness, it is an impossible goal, for physical pain is a fact of reality. And for many, such as yourself, the chronic type of pain that is overwhelming can be a massive disruption to the personal life.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I have a question regarding physical pain. Sometimes you can have situations where the pain can be crippling and I was wondering if you could speak in general on how do you integrate that pain and try to keep a positive attitude about the situation that you’re in? Because sometimes it can get to be overwhelming. And it’s something that I’m struggling with quite a bit. And I was wondering if you could speak in general about it, and if there’s even a way to integrate the pain where you’re at least dealing with it sensibly?
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo, and I’m aware of the query, my sister. We wish to speak to this query with some sensitivity, for we are aware that the third-density bodies that you inhabit, the veiled experience that you currently experience, can create a very significant charge, you may say, against the experience of pain. The experience of bodily and physical pain can be, as you say, so completely overwhelming that it can hijack the rest of the experience of the individual. And we understand that there is much effort among your peoples to help alleviate this experience of pain, and that the goal of eliminating pain is one of the greatest goals of your medical community, you may say.
excerpts.post: To speak generally, as you have requested, we again can recommend an understanding or an exploration of this experience that focuses on the potential planning of such catalyst from before your incarnation. There are various reasons why an entity may put into their incarnational plan an experience of overwhelming pain. There are various reasons why an entity may experience any number of limitations or overwhelming experience. And indeed, it is our perception that many entities, prior to their incarnation, overestimate their ability to see through this overwhelming nature of the catalyst, and grapple—we correct this instrument—and grasp the true intended meaning of this catalyst.

excerpts.t: We unfortunately cannot comment specifically in ways that may help any individual to understand their specific pain. However, we would encourage again that any seeker contemplating this question attempt to understand what gift may be within the pain. And if such cannot be found due to the overwhelming nature of the pain, it can be helpful, you may say, to surrender, to allow the pain to be the overwhelming experience for what it is. And see if this pain can be loved and accepted and allowed as if you were the One Creator experiencing the entire universe, allowing all manner of joyful and difficult experiences—to put this pain into the context of every experience that you have had, of every experience that the Creator has, and see it as just one note among a symphony of creation.
excerpts.q: Hello, Q’uo. I have a question regarding physical pain. Sometimes you can have situations where the pain can be crippling and I was wondering if you could speak in general on how do you integrate that pain and try to keep a positive attitude about the situation that you’re in? Because sometimes it can get to be overwhelming. And it’s something that I’m struggling with quite a bit. And I was wondering if you could speak in general about it, and if there’s even a way to integrate the pain where you’re at least dealing with it sensibly?
excerpts.post: Though that one note may stand out as prominent in this very moment, it is indeed just one experience of an infinite creation. And that it too has its own proper place. But it is not permanent. The creation is dynamic, and it changes, and you, as a co-Creator within the creation, have the ability to experience great pain and great joy. Both can come and go within your direct experience, as you move through the cosmos on your journey home to the One Infinite Creator.

excerpts.t: This anger is a powerful source of energy. It is what the creation has not been created of but which has been a part of the creation of the One Infinite Creator since time began. For it is so easy to get angry at anyone or anything. The power of anger can be used by the spiritual seeker of truth to feel that anger for the self, to feel its power, to bask in its power, to then see that there is a way in which anger can become part of yourself, so that you can work with it as catalyst. You can see whatever one is angry at, whether it is your own being, another being, another country, or so forth, and then see that this anger helps the Creator to know Itself in one way.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, help us better understand anger. There seems to be a disproportionate amount of anger in the world. We are taught to accept and learn to love anger like all emotions, distilling its purity. Going a step further, how can we integrate this energy? Can we transmute it? What is anger’s rightful place in the human experience?
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo and am aware of your query, my sister. You have chosen a question which is rampant upon this planet at this time. The catalyst of anger, of seeming separation with oneself, with one’s neighbor, with one’s family, with another country, with anything that you may have anger for, or anyone could have anger for.

excerpts.t: But these three distortions resulted in a creation that we have called an illusion, and it is indeed an illusion. For how can infinity, which is unity, have an awareness of itself? In order to be aware, there must be something to be aware of, which then implies two-ness or finiteness. Indeed, that then implies that the infinite creation that you are a part of is in this sense an illusion. The seeming separation, the distance between the subject of you and whatever you are perceiving as object, is an illusion, but it is a divine illusion.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. That was beautiful. Can you comment on the infinity of the body? I have an easier time understanding the infinity of the mind and of the spirit. The physical vessel seems most limited to me. If we each contain the whole, is that our vessel or does that mean the physical material of the universe, stars, planets? Is that all considered the body of the individual?
excerpts.pre: Upon these three distortions, the rest of the creation is built, and indeed, this is not an event that happened at some point in your past. For in reality, there is no such thing as the past or the future. There is only the present moment in different configurations. But in each configuration, no matter how seemingly different, these three distortions are present. The very fundamental aspect of the creation is within you in every moment of these three distortions. In this way, we can say that infinity is contained and does exist within the body and the mind and the spirit.
excerpts.post: This was the desire of the One Infinite Creator, that you would experience limitation. And indeed the question, as you have posed it, points to a very important aspect of that limitation, and that is how you, as mind/body/spirit complexes, experience that finiteness. And the most poignant and important aspect of this experience is through, what you call and what we have called, the body complex. It is that vehicle which houses and helps your consciousness to have a vehicle within the illusion of space/time. It is that which allows you to experience the illusion of separation, and this is why we believe you have perceived within this query a seeming difficulty of understanding the body as infinite. For it is your most immediate experience of this separation.

excerpts.t: But you can balance this anger with your love that flows through you from the Creator. You can open your heart to the love of the Creator and let it flow into that anger and dissolve that anger, so that it is no more at this time, and realize that this anger may come back. But now you know how to deal with it, to accept it, to feel it, to make it become part of you and then to blend it with the love of the Creator.
excerpts.q: Q’uo, help us better understand anger. There seems to be a disproportionate amount of anger in the world. We are taught to accept and learn to love anger like all emotions, distilling its purity. Going a step further, how can we integrate this energy? Can we transmute it? What is anger’s rightful place in the human experience?
excerpts.post: This is the path that each of you will take at one time or another. For anger is a part of the third-density illusion that each of you lives beyond the veil of forgetting. The veil of forgetting hides that there is no need for anger, but the anger that you feel is one way that you can move forward on your spiritual journey of reunion with the One Infinite Creator by feeling the love for all around you that you before felt anger for.

excerpts.t: We appreciate further the framing that you have put within this question of the dynamics of healing these distortions and wounds, and the responsibility that one may have of healing not just oneself, but of offering healing to others. This is an incredibly important aspect and dynamic of this question, for it is our understanding and opinion that a healer who wishes to offer healing to others must find some minimal amount of balance and healing within the self, so that they may then offer such healing in an undistorted and open way for any other-self, that they may seek to heal or that they may seek to serve. Indeed, healing is the ultimate service, and any act of service that provides catalyst for an other-self to come to know themselves in a deeper way, whether it is understood as healing or any other type of expression is still, in many ways, healing.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Yeah, lately I’ve been experiencing feelings of anger, resentment, and impatience toward men and masculine energy, and as I sit with these feelings, I notice they seem connected to concerns with fairness and justice and an unequal distribution of responsibility. In other words, I see a lot of suffering in the world caused by wounded men, and then a disproportionate responsibility falling on women who are also wounded to help heal it, and I find this unfair, yet I’m confused and unclear about the spiritual nature of fairness itself when I find myself ruminating about fairness and justice. It comes from a place of love, but it doesn’t feel very loving or gracious. […]
excerpts.pre: We would reflect that the feelings that you have personally expressed—difficulty and anger in observing the dynamics, the need for healing, and the impetus of who offers that healing and what healing may be offered—are a result of the increasing fourth density energies. [There are] deep, deep distortions, that have resulted in many traumas and many individual and collective wounds. To have the light of fourth density shined upon so that they may be perceived and may express themselves causes these wounds to manifest, become known, and again be felt with the pain, difficulty, fear, and anger that not only generated them but also perpetuate them for as long as they remain unaddressed and unhealed.
excerpts.post: In order to seek this healing within the self, it is important to allow these feelings that you have expressed and identified within yourself to have the rightful place within one’s life and within oneself, for these feelings and these emotions are indeed divine, and they come to you as divine messengers from your deepest mind. They filter through to your consciousness from the wounds that exist within you, some that you recognize and some that you can identify, but some that are buried within your past, and even further wounds that exist not for you as an individual, but for you as a planet.

excerpts.t: We would end by reiterating, as we began, that your responsibility as your own mind/body/spirit complex, the seemingly individual self, is to first discover and love and heal the self, for one may not offer any healing to any other that one is not able to offer to the self. Indeed, the healing of an other is the healing of the self. You cannot do one without the other, and it must start with examining those wounds within the self and relieving oneself of the responsibility of healing others, for it is only in the healing of the self that you can serve as the catalyst that offers the potential of healing the others.
excerpts.q: Thank you.
