Yeah, lately I’ve been experiencing feelings of anger, resentment, and impatience toward men and masculine energy, and as I sit with these feelings, I notice they seem connected to concerns with fairness and justice and an unequal distribution of responsibility. In other words, I see a lot of suffering in the world caused by wounded men, and then a disproportionate responsibility falling on women who are also wounded to help heal it, and I find this unfair, yet I’m confused and unclear about the spiritual nature of fairness itself when I find myself ruminating about fairness and justice. It comes from a place of love, but it doesn’t feel very loving or gracious. […]
excerpts.pre: The ability for the masculine to realize this is essential for such healing, for it is true that, as we perceive it, particularly within your so-called Western cultures, it is not typical, or it is not custom for the masculine energies to turn inward and address the wounds, as you have identified them, to express the pain that is found within them in a clear and honest way. These wounds do get expressed in confused and painful ways that further perpetuate the imbalances and further create distortions that cause harm and trauma, but to encourage the masculine energies upon your planet, and those who identify with such energies, to seek within themselves the feminine, to seek within themselves the care and compassion of both self and other, is a key to unlocking and to relieving much of the pressure and the inertia that continues to create these dynamics to unfold these patterns to continue within your cultures.
excerpts.post: They may ask and expect and even demand that you offer this to them, but whatever distortions are embedded within this relationship, these demands and these requests from them, they are unable to infringe upon your own beingness. So long as you continue to seek the balanced state of love and compassion within yourself, they will not be able to penetrate into that inner sanctum within yourself that you cultivate with love and compassion, acceptance and non-judgment, whatever demands they lay upon you, whatever needs they say must be addressed by you.

excerpts.t: We know that fear is incredibly present on your planet for many reasons, and in many instances. Finding beauty outside of fear may be of help. Recognize that your fear is that lesson, a great gift, and that there’s much beauty, even in that fear. What an opportunity you have been gifted to experience fear, because it reminds you of all that you love.
excerpts.q: Yes, thank you. Q’uo, how can the mind/body/spirit complex balance and heal catalyst involving fear for its physical life, such as being pursued, threatened, or moved into harmful action toward an other-self in order to preserve its own life? To make an example, let’s say, while driving behind a logging truck, the mind can imagine the wood falling and causing injury or death. Though unlikely, this image might arise from prior conditioning stories, films, etc. and fear arise before conscious choice could be made. This also happens in dreams, for example, when the choice that I am making is based on fear rather than love and further energizing violent outcomes. […]
excerpts.pre: Whenever you can meditate upon that fear and see that whatever may hurt or maim or end this incarnation as you see it is but a moment in a long period of what you call time, that exists only in that moment, and that you yourself are beyond the bounds of time and space, you may find more space within yourself to have acceptance, to have understanding and forgiveness, to see every moment as pregnant with opportunity, rather than being so bound to this form, bound to this interaction with your environment, or with other-self.
excerpts.post: My friend, it is a natural part of your design. It is a part of your choice to have these knee-jerk moments where self-preservation is at the forefront of your mind and is the highest priority in your decision making, for it informs you of so much more than the present moment, so much more than what you see of yourself. In some ways, it is an incredibly concentrated yet distorted moment of love. You recognize all that you care about, you recognize all that you desire, for you feel that in that moment you may lose that, and that is understandable, but when you can have patience for that, and forgiveness for that moment, and take it with you, recognizing that it is okay, that this is but a moment, and that, as the artist sang in the tuning song prior [to this channeling] that you too will fly beyond this moment that you are here.

excerpts.t: This Love is your healer, and with that heart open, that infinite surgeon may work through you. For Love is of an intelligence incomprehensibly greater than incarnate intelligence. You are inside of Love. You are held by Love; and Love uses you, shall we say, It works through you. This Love is the Creator’s Love, felt by you as a separate being. And this Love, if you follow it, if you allow it, if you are with it and see where it leads you, like your breadcrumbs in the fairy tale, shall we say, this Love will lead you back to the Creator which Loves you and which you love, but may not yet know it consciously.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. I’ve sometimes felt confused with the concept of love in the Law of One between the true primal nature of the Creator, which has been described as beautiful and terrible, creative and destructive, and the love we are told to share with self and other-self, which is usually understood as unconditional love as well as compassion, generosity, kindness, and fellowship, etc. Can you explain and perhaps offer what is a healthy and helpful evolution of this concept?
excerpts.pre: If thus love’s lack is at the root, then the restoration, the redemption, the healing is through the activation of this center and the free giving of this love to one another, to your political systems, to your economic and social systems, to your interpersonal relationships, and so forth.
excerpts.post: This Creator that you seek, this Creator that is the destination, from your perspective, that is your hope and your dreams in the misplaced searching for satisfaction in status or possessions or so forth; this Love is your communication channel to the Creator. It is within you. It is you, and that which obscures this Love falls away the more that you may allow and embrace and become this Love, feeling yourself worthy of this Love. For you are worthy. You cannot not be. It is a story that you tell yourselves that you are unworthy of divine, perfect love.

excerpts.t: Those of you who walk this incarnation with a broken heart or pain or baggage due to the parent-child relationship, we ask that you lovingly tend to that hurt child. That you approach that inner child with the same grace that a most loving and accepting parent would. That you treat that inner child in the way that you wish you had been treated, with full love and acceptance, with patience and grace, with understanding, and of course, always with affirmations of perfection.
excerpts.q: Yes, can you speak to the spiritual nature of family relationships, specifically parents and children? How do we best analyze this unique relationship for spiritual revelation?
excerpts.pre: All of these potentials are made more complex, the catalyst more concentrated due to the fact that there is shared DNA. Due to the fact that the agreements were made many lifetimes ago. Due to the fact that your shared space, your shared name, at times, only hastens and accentuates the love, the anger, the pain, the healing.
excerpts.post: Those of you who are parents who have experienced pain in the relationship with the child, we simply ask that you continue to strive to be open-hearted and accepting, to witness the child where they are, to see them in their imperfect perfection, and to learn to love them unconditionally regardless of that pain, regardless of disappointment or of unmet expectations. And if they continue to walk away from the love that you give, that you not weaken that love for an instant. Though they may not feel that love from afar, consciously, at a soul level, you are tending to them. You are acting upon that agreement that you made.

excerpts.t: And we understand that there are those on the other side who incarnated in a most loving, accepting, beautiful family, where parent and child get along like best friends, like soulmates, and in those situations as well, there is much catalyst. The initial part of the incarnation may seem like smooth sailing, but the greater catalyst comes later in life. Perhaps when child must tend to parent as they age and deteriorate and must say goodbye as they transition. Or perhaps in situations where the child transitions before the parent, and the parent must then undergo a great sense and a great journey of loss and grief, of understanding how this could happen.
excerpts.q: Yes, can you speak to the spiritual nature of family relationships, specifically parents and children? How do we best analyze this unique relationship for spiritual revelation?
excerpts.pre: At times, that can result in the martyr’s path, and at times, it can generate a most beautiful blossoming both for child and for parent, for abused and abuser. Because again, an agreement was made, however seemingly outside of reality it may seem in this incarnation.

excerpts.t: The more that the entity activates their heart and widens the scope of love to a universality, to learning to give without expectation of return, to learning to hold life in love with less and less, and ultimately no condition, the more that the higher centers are activated and this love is brought upward; the more that the entity radiates this love and light and light and love without effort, by virtue of their beingness, as we spoke previously. And this emanation is one’s most fundamental and profound service.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. On December 29, 2007, you are recorded as saying, and I quote: For you heard the cry of earth, and you hope to hold the light at this time in a dark world, so that gradually, as you allow the light of the Creator to shine through you, you could infect others with this joy and effortless flow of life and love that is coming through each of you at all times. And yet, so seldom is it acknowledged, blessed, and given a boost as it goes through your energy system and out into the world. […]
excerpts.pre: Indeed, our brother, there is no entity who was ever, or will ever, or could ever be separate from the One and from love and light. It is within the entity’s capacity, however, to block, and distort, and misapprehend this love and light. But for those with relatively open and balanced, in, at minimum, the first triad combined with the green ray, love/light is flowing naturally through the entity, whether or not consciously perceived, and it may indeed… or, we would edit that word, and say, it is often the case that the entity is not recognizing this love/light that is flowing through, that is present within the center of each cell within the body, each place within the mind complex, and streaming through from intelligent infinity through the spirit channel.
excerpts.post: But as the question supposes, that love/light may be harnessed and directed, as you said, given a boost, amplified and intensified, fundamentally through intention, through honoring that the self is, from your perspective, a child of the Creator, made in and as and for the Creator.

excerpts.t: First and foremost, upon a metaphysical level, do you practice sending love to your planet? We assure you, this planet feels every act in every vibration of love, and resonates and reverberates with that love. But you may also direct and send that love intentionally and consciously to your planetary mother with reverence and free offering that the places of darkness, the places of the hatred and so forth may be transmuted and healed, returning to that great energy from which those distorted energies came, that being Love.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. What can we do to alleviate the climate issues currently besetting our planet: fires, excessive heat, drought, floods, etc.?
excerpts.pre: You may form a collaborative stewardship with your earth such that you know that this ground upon which you walk, be it soil, or rock, or sand, or wherever your feet may take you, including within the human-made structure, is holy ground, is a miracle to experience; and you may give this gratitude, and you may connect your heart to the heart of the planet and to all hearts around the world, doing this light work with an intention, with a quest to heal your world.
excerpts.post: We see within this instrument’s mind other outer practices which may support this healing and this change, including that of the regenerative agriculture, the restorative justice, the alternative healing modalities, including the energy work, the plant medicine work. And those practices which may not make your, as you would say, mainstream news, but which are arising around the margins like little sprouts of new plant life on the forest floor, beginning their upward growth and waiting for the greater light of planetary attention to offer your peoples vehicles and modalities and means to come together hand in hand in greater respect for each other and your world.

excerpts.t: For it is not just this spherical body of first and second density which needs [most] healed, it is your peoples. And those actions which help to uplift those upon your planet, to heal broken hearts, to heal drug addiction, and the pathologies of the mind, and the punitive justice system, and to heal and transform the economic incentives that perpetuate this world-destroying machine, and so on, are available.
excerpts.q: Yes, Q’uo. What can we do to alleviate the climate issues currently besetting our planet: fires, excessive heat, drought, floods, etc.?
excerpts.post: And through your own creativity, our friends, you may find myriad ways to offer to this world new practices, perhaps undreamed of. Or ways from within institutions to begin moving those needles, to begin transforming them. Maybe through dismantlement, maybe through evolution, but always through love, through a revolution of love.

excerpts.t: And as you gather each time, this energy continues to crystallize. It continues to form an interface for the love and the light of the One Infinite Creator to shine through you into this world. We would sometimes say that such a gathering generates light, but it is more accurate to say that it allows the light that is already present to be more readily perceived, to flow into your space/time, and to become more and more available to you and to your world. This is a great blessing for your planet, for as it continues its transition into the fourth density of love and understanding, it continues to call for the increased coherent light that you may offer through such gatherings.
excerpts.q: The nature of resonance with the Confederation’s message; considering parenthood in a complex and uncertain world; the meaning of sacrifice in third density.
excerpts.pre: I am Q’uo. We greet this circle in the love and in the light of the One Infinite Creator. We are blessed and honored to be invited to this circle of seeking with you this day. We will reflect some upon our perception of this circle and the regular gathering that has occurred in this city, as you call it. For we are aware that this particular style of gathering has been recurring here, and we have been invited to join you for each of these gatherings these past years. And though we recognize that there is a new space/time in which this group gathers, and though there are new mind/body/spirit complexes among this group, there is an energy, or a vibration, or even a group song, as you may perceive it, that is carried forth with this group. Those who have been a part of this group have offered themselves to it, and their energy persists. And those who are new may tap into that regular crystallizing energy, and offer their own unique imprint upon it.
excerpts.post: We ourselves continue to contribute in our own way to such gatherings, and your invitation to us to join you and to offer our thoughts and opinions upon your queries allows us to take part in this glorious transformation of your planet that you are aiding through such gatherings.

excerpts.t: And once you have looked through and made sense, or at least begun the journey of making sense of what this feeling is communicating to you, then you may begin to more fully examine the bigger decision, this decision of bringing life, or fostering the life one has. This is not to say that bringing a life into this incarnation precludes oneself from fully living one’s life. In fact, there is something very special about the relationship between parent and child. One that gives its own certain flavor of catalyst. That is a connection that is very unique. However, it is not limited to the biological family. That connection that you may seek between parent and child does not rely on blood and DNA alone. You may find those connections in your everyday life, be it the care of a plant, of an animal, the friend, of a family member. Family, in general, can be chosen.
excerpts.q: Thank you, Q’uo. This question is in considering the possibility of becoming a father. I feel overwhelmed lately by the responsibility/honor in potentially bringing a child into this complex world. What thoughts can you, Q’uo, offer for couples considering bringing a child into this world?
excerpts.pre: Ask those questions of yourself in your times of meditation, in your spaces for contemplation. Really review them to understand why you have this feeling. Because again, my friend, that feeling is not [necessarily] specific to this situation, though it may seem as though [that is the case]. That lesson, whatever it is, will present one way or the other. Perhaps not tomorrow, but surely it will see you again.
excerpts.post: It is not strictly through this biological process that family can be made. However, there is beauty as well to the biological process of making a family. There is the physical act, which is a sexual investment of loving energy, a true act of intimacy and authenticity, vulnerability, receiving and accepting. There is also the emotional and mental interaction that occurs in these types of decisions. The potential conversations about commitment, about planning, about shared journey, about shared intention. That, too, is very powerful and informative to the soul. Gifting again many opportunities for catalyst.

excerpts.t: It is this desire within the heart of the seeker that alerts us to your learning of our words, your perceiving of our teachings. When you combine this reading of our words with a desire within your heart, we are able to resonate with such desire. And indeed, it is our desire to be with you in some way.
excerpts.q: Thank you. When a seeker reads a Confederation transcript and holds the source in mind, they are sometimes filled with the feeling characteristic of that source. When such an impression comes, how can the seeker understand the relationship between the actual Confederation source, their guidance system, and the impression they’re feeling? Is the impression they’re receiving coming from the actual source itself, offered within the seeker’s free will, or is it their own deeper mind simply resonating with the vibration, or is it a blending of these? Thank you.
excerpts.pre: When a seeker becomes aware of our words, through whatever means, if there is no innate desire to connect with us, then the seeker is indeed only working upon the self. There is no resonance or alert to us, you may say, that we would join you. However, we find more and more, as more of your time passes, that there is a growing desire within the hearts of those seekers who become aware of our words, and indeed those people upon your planet, to reach out, to call to the Confederation of Planets in Service to the One Infinite Creator, to see your planet as one among many, among the stars, and to join us in some way and in some fashion.
excerpts.post: But we would offer a caution, you may say, that there are various ways for us to interact with seekers when they have such a desire. We would ask that seekers who become aware of this desire, who find value in our words, to meditate deeply upon that desire, and to become mindful of that which they are calling for, become mindful of how they wish to receive our influence and our inspiration and our catalyst, for there are different ways for us to interact with you.

excerpts.t: The path of the parent—as contrasted to that of the monk, as the question framed it—is one of the most difficult available to those of your planet, my friends. The daily unremitting sacrifice and devotion and giving of the self to an other or others is a testing and a development of the will and the faith to seek and to serve that the monk may not quite have the benefit of in their quietude and perhaps solitude. The parent is offered enormous and profound opportunity to work upon many, many balances within the self to activate and clear and refine each and every energy center, particularly that of learning to love without condition. For as every parent will know, the child presents to the parent or the guardian many mirrors, which reflect back to the parent the limitations upon their patience, upon their ability to accept, or perhaps forgive, or communicate with clarity and compassion. And the relationship of the parent to the child is one which is a case study unto itself of the dynamics of free will, and how the free will of the other-self will be honored or abridged, manipulated or supported, and how these two or more free wills will learn to relate and harmonize or disharmonize.
excerpts.q: The question is, in my life, I feel the continuous challenge of being a parent and a pull towards being a monk. I feel that in my role as boss, parent, and a monk, I do neither fully. I would like to meditate all day and live in silence. I would like to spend time with my children and give them my full direction as a mentor and a guide. I feel like I fail in both, and I know that both roles are a beautiful service to others. How, Q’uo, might I let go of the imperfection in these two roles and let go of the guilt of confusion, to offer the best of myself as a whole person: the parent, the monk, and the human?
excerpts.pre: Yet, you wish to spend clock time in the seeking, to devote your hours, your mornings, your evenings, and your afternoons in the practice of the spiritual discipline and the seeking. Our friends, this can be brought to bear on virtually any role or vocation or circumstance. It is a matter of your attention. We acknowledge that it is not easy in the day-to-day world, particularly when raising children, to sustain this presence, this attention, and this seeing, but the difficulty of doing so is in proportion to the possibility of growth and service and profound realization of the Creator through the development of the will and the faith that such opportunity offers.
excerpts.post: The monk in their studies, who may burn equally, has not these opportunities of the parent, this ocean of catalysts that may greet the parent on a day-to-day basis. Both seeming roles offer the entity the opportunity for patience and endurance, the cultivation of will and faith, the training of the attention, and so on.

excerpts.t: We recognize that anger and fear underlie a lot of the events you see around the planet right now, and we hold you close in that regard. Knowing that when anger is felt on global levels, regional levels, and national levels it can be challenging to live one’s own personal life in your identity, separated self, without feeling touched by that anger, or perhaps feeling like you’re on the receiving end of that anger. This honest work of knowing and understanding anger is so important. For the longer you spend in anger and you get to know anger and you forgive anger and you wish it well, you thank it for its opportunity, the sooner you find that peace, and then you begin to radiate that peace outward to your other-selves. You begin to offer opportunities to then be the receiving of the anger and may begin to be a beacon of inspiration for that other-self who reacted to you with anger, showing others how it is okay. I still love you. I forgive you. I wish you well. You are perfect. For that’s all that you can be.
excerpts.q: Hello Q’uo. When anger arises, is remaining silent more aligned with STO than sharing one’s feelings, given that the latter may offer emotional energy the other-self has not requested, and could thus tilt, even slightly, toward STS? What principles govern these dynamics of expression, free will, and polarity?
excerpts.pre: Shame, insecurity, all these emotions can be better understood when one has full acceptance of self in a loving and kind way. Seeing oneself as the child who is attempting to make sense of this playground, and the mother who extends her loving arms to hold the child, knowing that it can be very confusing and overwhelming, and you will trip, you will fall. But that you always have the ability to stand back up, to take note of why you tripped, and to continue forward in faith.
excerpts.post: Again, we are very appreciative of this question. We understand that there is much that could be mined on this emotion of anger, but just know that it is a cornucopia from which you can select; on some conscious level, you can find that which expresses yourself more fully. And you can do so with more love, more light. It is with practice, it is with faith, it is with the honing of your will that you will find that means of expressing yourself.

excerpts.t: The next step of walking through the terrain that you have set a foot upon is of great importance. And through this instrument, we see the importance of the apology, of the genuine feeling of sorrow for the manifestation of the anger or for the pain that the other-self has been catalyzed. And so being able to work through that anger, expressing yourself as clearly as possible with other-self, is also an important step in that direction towards the balancing of this anger. Putting a narrative or a descriptor to your anger, so that other-self may understand where that anger is seated, can be helpful, but always important in understanding where that anger is seated is the factor and the element that it is ultimately seated within you. Other-self does not produce your anger. That is your responsibility, and when you can hold it with love, with a gentle touch, you can express it. And you can help other-self to understand that your anger is not a reflection on them. If done quickly, or if done with an open heart, or even if done over many months but with pure intentions, situations that involve anger can be dissolved and provide immense wells for personal growth, for spiritual evolution. For you begin to see the dynamics that afforded you this opportunity, this great opportunity.
excerpts.q: Hello Q’uo. When anger arises, is remaining silent more aligned with STO than sharing one’s feelings, given that the latter may offer emotional energy the other-self has not requested, and could thus tilt, even slightly, toward STS? What principles govern these dynamics of expression, free will, and polarity?
excerpts.pre: For in reality, the reaction was and always is within you. It is your responsibility. And as you express this anger authentically, witness what comes up. For you are providing potent catalyst for the other-self as well. Understand that if there is pain involved in that anger, that is again a manifestation of Creator in creation. Understand that it may have impact. That it may injure a relationship. And so, once you are able to manifest that anger authentically, you can take a deep breath. You can look with loving eyes on the other-self and, just as importantly, on the self. And you can find pathways towards acceptance, towards understanding, towards forgiveness, and towards healing. We realize that that may be a challenging topic or piece of information to digest. For again, one does not mostly wish to express anger, especially to those that one loves and cares about.

excerpts.t: That which is infinite cannot be many, for many-ness is a finite concept. To have infinity you must identify or define that infinity as unity; otherwise, the term does not have any referent or meaning. In an Infinite Creator there is only unity. You have seen simple examples of unity. You have seen the prism which shows all colors stemming from the sunlight. This is a simplistic example of unity.
excerpts.q: [The question was lost because the questioner was sitting too far from the tape recorder to be recorded.]
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. Consider, if you will, that the universe is infinite. This has yet to be proven or disproven, but we can assure you that there is no end to your selves, your understanding, what you would call your journey of seeking, or your perceptions of the creation.
excerpts.post: In truth there is no right or wrong. There is no polarity, for all will be, as you would say, reconciled at some point in your dance through the mind/body/spirit complex which you amuse yourself by distorting in various ways at this time. This distortion is not in any case necessary. It is chosen by each of you as an alternative to understanding the complete unity of thought which binds all things.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. We communicate now. We, too, have our place. We are not those of the Love [density] or of the Light [density]. We are those who are of the Law of One. In our vibration the polarities are harmonized, the complexities are simplified, and the paradoxes have their solution. We are one. That is our nature and our purpose.
excerpts.q: It seems members of the Confederation have a specific purpose. Is this true with you, and if so, what is your purpose?
excerpts.post: We are old upon your planet and have served with varying degrees of success in transmitting the Law of One, of Unity, of Singleness to your peoples. We have walked your earth. We have seen the faces of your peoples. This is not so with many of the entities of the Confederation. We found it was not efficacious.

excerpts.t: Firstly, you must understand that the distinction between yourself and others is not visible to us. We do not consider that a separation exists between the consciousness-raising efforts of the distortion which you project as a personality, and the distortion which you project as an other personality. Thus, to learn is the same as to teach unless you are not teaching what you are learning; in which case you have done you/they little or no good. This understanding should be pondered by your mind/body/spirit complex as it is a distortion which plays a part in your experiences at this nexus.
excerpts.q: Another question. Is it possible to create any acceleration of understanding [in] other entities [or are] all efforts… efforts by the individual on himself accelerating his understanding? In other words, if an individual tries to act as a catalyst in general to increase the awareness of planetary consciousness, is he doing nothing but acting upon himself, or is it possible [inaudible]?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. We shall answer your question in two parts, both of which are important equally.

excerpts.t: Exercise One. This is the most nearly centered and usable within your illusion complex. The moment contains love. That is the lesson/goal of this illusion or density. The exercise is to consciously seek that love in awareness and understanding-distortions. The first attempt is the cornerstone. Upon this choosing rests the remainder of the life-experience of an entity. The second seeking of love within the moment begins the addition. The third seeking powers the second, the fourth powering or doubling the third. As with the previous type of empowerment, there will be some loss of power due to flaws within the seeking in the distortion of insincerity. However, the conscious statement of self to self of the desire to seek love is so central an act of will that, as before, the loss of power due to this friction is inconsequential.
excerpts.q: For general development of the reader of this book, could you state some of the practices or exercises to perform to produce an acceleration toward the Law of One?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra.
excerpts.post: Exercise Two. The universe is one being. When a mind/body/spirit complex views another mind/body/spirit complex, see the Creator. This is an helpful exercise.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. Many of these entities were able to remove the accumulation of what you call karma, thus being able to accept a third-density cycle within a third-density body. Most of those beings so succeeding have incarnated elsewhere in the creation for the succeeding cycle in third density. As this planet reached third density, some few of these entities became able to join the vibration of this sphere in the third-density form. There remain a few who have not yet alleviated, through the mind/body/spirit coordination of distortions, the previous action taken by them. Therefore, they remain.
excerpts.q: Well, have any of these entities moved on now, made a, shall we say, graduation at the end of a seventy-five thousand year cycle and gotten out of the second-density body into third-density-type bodies?

excerpts.t: The consciousness of these entities has always been third-density. The alleviation mechanism was designed by the placement of this consciousness in second-dimensional physical chemical complexes which are not able to be dexterous or manipulative to the extent which is appropriate to the workings of the third-density distortions of the mind complex.
excerpts.q: And have any of the Maldek entities transformed now? Are they now still second-density, or are they forming some third-density planet now?

excerpts.t: The polarities are both dependent upon a limited viewpoint. However, the negative polarity depends more heavily upon the illusory separation betwixt the self and all other mind/body/spirit complexes. The positive polarity attempts to see through the illusion to the Creator in each mind/body/spirit complex, but for the greater part is concerned with behaviors and thoughts directed towards other-selves in order to be of service.
excerpts.q: It would also seem to me that since Ra stated in the last session the limit of the viewpoint is the source of all distortions, that the very nature of the service-to-self distortions that create the left-hand path are a function of the veil and, therefore, are dependent, you might say, to some degree on at least a partial continued veiling. Does this make any sense?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. There is the thread of logic in what you suppose.
excerpts.post: This attitude in itself is full of the stuff of your third-density illusion.

excerpts.t: We may further note that the negatively polarized adept will attempt to fashion that covenant for its own use, whereas the positively polarized entity may hold forth that which is exemplified by the astrological sword; that is, light and truth.
excerpts.q: In that case I will ask only one more question and that will be having to do with the sword and the scepter. It would seem that the sword would be the power of the negative adept indicating control over other-selves, and the scepter would indicate the power of the positive adept with unity in mind, body, and spirit. However, they seem to be in opposite hands than I would have guessed. Would Ra comment on that?
excerpts.pre: We may note that there is an overriding spiritual environment and protection for the environment of the mind.

excerpts.t: The conscious entity holds both and will turn itself one way or the other, or potentially backwards and forwards, rocking first one way, then the other, and not achieving the Transformation. In order for the Transformation of Mind to occur, one principle governing the use of the deep mind must be abandoned.
excerpts.q: Thank you. To continue with the tarot, I would like to make the additional observation with respect to Card Six that the male’s arms being crossed, if the female to his right pulls on his left hand it would cant, in effect turn him, his entire body, toward the right. And the same is true for the female on the left: pulling on his right hand she will turn his entire body to her side. Which is my interpretation of what’s meant by the tangle of the arms—that the transformation occurs by pull which attempts to turn the entity toward the left- or the right-hand path. Would Ra comment on that observation?
excerpts.pre: In this image of Transformation of Mind, then, each of the females points the way it would go but is not able to move; nor are the two female entities striving to do so. They are at rest.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The nature of catalyst is such that there is only one source, for the catalyst and experience are further attempts at specificity in dealing with the architecture of the unconscious mind of the self. Therefore, in an incarnational experience the self as Creator, especially the higher self, is the base from which catalyst stands to offer its service to the mind, body, or spirit.
excerpts.q: In this particular case, which avenue was the one that produced the catalyst of the bite?
excerpts.post: In the sense which we feel you intend, the source was the fifth-density negative friend which had noted the gradual falling away of the inharmonious patterns of the distortion called anger/frustration in the entity. The insect was easily led to an attack, and the physical vehicle, which had long-standing allergies and sensitivities, was also easily led into the mechanisms of the failure of lymphatic function and the greatly diminished ability of the immune system to remove from the yellow-ray body that which distorted it.

excerpts.t: The entity which is given constant and unremitting approval by those surrounding it suffers from the loss of the mirroring effect of those which reflect truthfully rather than unquestioningly. This is not a suggestion to reinstate judgment but merely a suggestion for all those supporting instruments; that is, support, be harmonious, share in love, joy, and thanksgiving, but find love within truth, for each instrument benefits from this support more than from the total admiration which overcomes discrimination.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Could Ra give information on any way that we could give information to Greta Woodrew as to how to alleviate her present condition of swelling?

excerpts.t: Therefore, look not to a healing but to the joy of companionship, for each is strong and has its feet set upon the way. The moon casts its shadows. What shall you see? Link hands and walk towards the sun. In this instance this is the greatest healing. For the physical vehicle we can suggest far less than you had hoped.
excerpts.q: Obviously we would very much like to not get to the point of surgery, and the only other alternative that comes to mind—other than the diet and the instrument’s personal mental work—is healing through a healer. And I would like Ra’s recommendation with respect to a non-allopathic type healer and any recommendations Ra could make for either Jim or myself to act in that capacity, or anyone else Ra could recommend so that we wouldn’t have to go through this surgical operation if it seems to become necessary. And if we could start working on one of these other approaches right away I think it might be highly recommended. Would Ra comment on that, please?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. We salute the opening of compassion circuitry in the questioner but note that that which is being experienced by this group is being experienced within an healing atmosphere. The healing hands of each have limited use when the distortion has so many metaphysical layers and mixtures.
excerpts.q: Obviously we would very much like to not get to the point of surgery, and the only other alternative that comes to mind—other than the diet and the instrument’s personal mental work—is healing through a healer. And I would like Ra’s recommendation with respect to a non-allopathic type healer and any recommendations Ra could make for either Jim or myself to act in that capacity, or anyone else Ra could recommend so that we wouldn’t have to go through this surgical operation if it seems to become necessary. And if we could start working on one of these other approaches right away I think it might be highly recommended. Would Ra comment on that, please?

excerpts.t: In order to observe the cause of physical distortions toward illness one must look to the energy center which is blocked. In this situation, the blockage being yellow-ray, the experience has had the characteristics of that region of the chemical body. The so-called lacuna in the wind-written armor of light and love was closed and not only repaired but much improved.
excerpts.q: Will Ra please tell us what caused the pain and cramping in the instrument’s stomach, and what could be done to heal it?
excerpts.post: However, the distortions energized during this momentary lapse from free energy flow are serious and shall be continuing for, in all possibility/probability vortices, some of your space/time, for a predisposition to spasticity in the transverse colon has been energized.

excerpts.t: Thus the catalyst was given in a more complete form. The outer service to others became nearly impossible, causing the entity to experience, once again, the choice of the martyr: that is, to put value in a fatal action and die, or to put value on consciousness of the creation and of the One Creator and, thereby, live. The instrument, through will, chose the latter path.
excerpts.q: The instrument asks the question why she lost her joy in the recent past? Would Ra comment, please?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. The instrument made a free-will decision not to address the physical catalyst causing great pain by means of the allopathically prescribed chemical compound, which the instrument was sure would be efficacious due to its reliance upon the suggestions of Ra.
excerpts.post: However, the mind and mental/emotional distortions did not give the support to this decision necessary to maintain a state of unity which this entity normally experiences and has experienced since its incarnation’s beginnings.

excerpts.t: The Great Way of the Mind, the Body, or the Spirit draws the environment which has been the new architecture caused by the veiling process and, thusly, dipped in the great, limitless current of time/space.
excerpts.q: Would Ra comment on that?

excerpts.t: The entire mood, shall we say, of the Great Way is, indeed, dependent upon its notable difference from the Significator. The Significator is the significant self, to a great extent but not entirely, influenced by the lowering of the veil.
excerpts.q: Would Ra comment on that?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. The use of the tau and the architect’s square is, indeed, intended to suggest the proximity of the space/time of the Great Way’s environment to time/space. We find this observation most perceptive.

excerpts.t: We would further note that balancing—which, in this entity’s case, is best accomplished in analysis and manifestation seated with the contemplation of silence—may be strengthened by manifested silence and lack of routine activity. We may go no further than this recommendation of regularized leisure, and desire that the entity discover the fundamental truths of these distortions as it will.
excerpts.q: The instrument has determined that the unwise use of her will is its use without the joy and faith components and constitutes martyrdom. Would Ra comment on that, please?
excerpts.pre: It is salubrious for the instrument to have knowledge which is less distorted towards martyrdom and which is rich in promise. The entity which is strong to think shall either be strong to act or that which it has shall be removed. Thus manifestation of knowledge is an area to be examined by the instrument.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The anger of separation is impossible without the veil. The lack of awareness of the body’s need for liquid is unlikely without the veil. The decision to contemplate perfection in discipline is quite improbable without the veil.
excerpts.q: Now, as an example I would like to take the distortion of a disease or bodily malfunction prior to the veil and compare it to that after the veil. Let us assume that the conditions that Jim, for instance, experienced with respect to his kidney malfunction had been an experience that occurred prior to the veil. Would this experience have occurred prior to the veil? Would it have been different? And if so, how?

excerpts.t: The patterns of illness, disease, and death are a benignant demesne within the plan of incarnational experience. As such, some healing would occur by decision of mind/body/spirits, and incarnations were experienced with the normal ending of illness to death, accepted as such since, without the veil, it is clear that the mind/body/spirit continues. Thusly, the experiences, both good and bad, or joyful and sad, of the mind/body/spirit before veiling would be pale, without vibrancy or the keen edge of interest that such brings in the post-veiling mind/body/spirit complex.
excerpts.q: Now, I would like to, then, examine a sample, shall we say, bodily distortion prior to the veil and how it would affect the mind. Could Ra give an example of that, please?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. This general area has been covered. We shall recapitulate here.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The description which began your query is suitable for the function of the mind/body/spirit or the mind/body/spirit complex. The position in creation of physical manifestation changed not one whit when the veil of forgetting was dropped.
excerpts.q: We have been, you might say, experimentally determining a lot of things about the body—the next portion of the tarot—and have been experiencing some of the feedback effects, I might say, between the mind and the body. I sense, from everything that we have done so far with respect to these effects, that the great value of the third-density, yellow-ray body at this time is as a device that feeds back catalyst to a mind to create the polarization. […]

excerpts.t: The nature of this entity is gay and sociable so that it is fed by those things we have mentioned previously: the varieties of experience with other-selves and other locations and events being helpful, as well as the experience of worship and the singing, especially of sacred music.
excerpts.q: How serious and critical is this renal problem? Is drinking liquids (I assume water is the best) the only thing we can do for that, or is there something else?
excerpts.pre: However, the desire to leave and be no more a portion of this particular experiential nexus can and has been energized. This is a point for the instrument to ponder, and an appropriate point for the support group to be watchful in regards to care for the instrument. So are mind and body plaited up as the tresses of hair of a maiden.

excerpts.t: This entity chose to enter a worshipful situation with a martyr’s role when first in this geographical location. Therefore, the feeding by worship has taken place only partially. Similarly the musical activities, though enjoyable and therefore of a feeding nature, have not included the aspect of praise to the Creator.
excerpts.q: How serious and critical is this renal problem? Is drinking liquids (I assume water is the best) the only thing we can do for that, or is there something else?
excerpts.post: The instrument is in a state of relative hunger for those spiritual homes which it gave up when it felt a call to martyrdom and turned from the planned worship at the location you call the Cathedral of St. Philip. This, too, shall be healed gradually due to the proposed alteration in location of this group.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. A mind/body/spirit social complex becomes a social memory complex when its entire group of entities are of one orientation or seeking. The group memory lost to the individuals in the roots of the tree of mind then become[s] known to the social complex, thus creating a social memory complex. The advantages of this complex are the relative lack of distortion in understanding the social beingness and the relative lack of distortion in pursuing the direction of seeking, for all understanding-distortions are available to the entities of the society.
excerpts.q: At what stage does a planet achieve social memory?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The planetary social memory complex, Maldek, had in common with your own sphere the situation of a mixture of energy direction. Thus it, though unknown, would most probably have been a mixed harvest—a few moving to fourth density, a few moving towards fourth density in service to self, the great majority repeating third density. This is approximate due to the fact that parallel possibility/probability vortices cease when action occurs and new probability/possibility vortices are begun.
excerpts.q: You said yesterday that Maldek was destroyed due to warfare. If Maldek hadn’t destroyed itself due to warfare, would it have become a planet that evolved with self-service? And would the entities have increased in density, gone on to, say, the fourth, fifth density in the negative sense or the sense of self-service?

excerpts.t: As all, they follow the Law of One observing free will. Contact is made with those who call. Those then upon the planetary sphere act much as do you to disseminate the attitudes and philosophy of their particular understanding of the Law of One, which is service to self. These become the elite. Through these, the attempt begins to create a condition whereby the remainder of the planetary entities are enslaved by their own free will.
excerpts.q: Then we have crusaders from Orion coming to this planet for mind control purposes. How do they do this?

excerpts.t: When a social memory complex has achieved its complete understanding of its desire, it may conclude that its desire is service to others with the distortion towards reaching their hand, figuratively, to any entities who call for aid. These entities, whom you may call the Brothers and Sisters of Sorrow, move towards this calling of sorrow. These entities are from all reaches of the infinite creation and are bound together by the desire to serve in this distortion.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Well, you spoke of wanderers. Who are wanderers? Where do they come from?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. Imagine, if you will, the sands of your shores. As countless as the grains of sand are the sources of intelligent infinity.

excerpts.t: The seventh, or violet, ray is unimpaired, this being not only an energy receptor but a sum total of the vibratory level of the individual. The other energy centers are also quite clear. The solution to healing in this case is action that puts into practice the peaceful understanding, in humility-distortion, that the entity is one with the Creator, therefore perfected and not separate. In each case of what you would call ill health, one or more of these energy centers is blocked. The intelligence of the mind/body/spirit complex needs, then, to be alerted either by the self as healer or by the catalyst of another healer, as we have said before.
excerpts.q: Is there a best way for these entities to heal themselves of their physical ailments?
excerpts.post: Is there a short question before we close this session?

excerpts.t: This instrument also experiences some distortion of the green-ray energy center which you may call the heart center. It is overly open due to an intensive desire-distortion on the part of this mind/body/spirit complex towards service to others, or as you may call it, universal love. This entity, therefore, spends itself without regard to its reserves of mind/body/spirit-complex distortion in regard to what you call strength or energy. This distortion is primarily due to the blockage of the indigo ray, as we have said before. The misapprehension-distortion of the instrument responsible for this blockage is the basic orientation towards a belief in unworthiness. The unworthiness-distortion blocks the free flow of intelligent energy.
excerpts.q: Is there a best way for these entities to heal themselves of their physical ailments?
excerpts.pre: We will use this instrument as example. The portions of its ailment, as you call this distortion complex, that can be perfected in balance are due primarily to a blockage of the indigo-ray, or pineal, energy center. This center receives the intelligent energy from all sources lawful within the One Creation; that is, lawful in this third-density distortion or illusion. If there is no blockage, these energies pour or stream down into the mind/body/spirit complex, perfecting, moment by moment, the individual’s body complex.

excerpts.t: Awareness led to the focus of infinity into infinite energy. You have called this by various vibrational sound complexes, the most common to your ears being “Logos” or “Love.” The Creator is the focusing of infinity as an aware or conscious principle called by us, as closely as we can create understanding/learning in your language, intelligent infinity.
excerpts.q: After this, what happened?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The second density strives towards the third density, which is the density of self-consciousness, or self-awareness. The striving takes place through the higher second-density forms who are invested by third-density beings with an identity to the extent that they become self-aware mind/body complexes, thus becoming mind/body/spirit complexes and entering third density, the first density of consciousness of spirit.
excerpts.q: Then how does the second density progress to the third?

excerpts.t: Thus, the entry into the vibration of love, sometimes called by your people the vibration of understanding, is not effective with the present societal complex. Thus, the harvest shall be such that many will repeat the third-density cycle. The energies of your wanderers, your teachers, and your adepts at this time are all bent upon increasing the harvest. However, there are few to harvest.
excerpts.q: How does a third-density planet become a fourth-density?
excerpts.pre: The fourth density is, as we have said, as regularized in its approach as the striking of a clock upon the hour. The space/time of your solar system has enabled this planetary sphere to spiral into space/time of a different vibrational configuration. This causes the planetary sphere to be able to be molded by these new distortions. However, the thought-forms of your people during this transition period are such that the mind/body/spirit complexes of both individual and societies are scattered throughout the spectrum instead of becoming able to grasp the needle, shall we say, and point the compass in one direction.

excerpts.t: There was not this type of investment as spoken but the simple third-density investment which is the line of spiraling light calling distortion upward from density to density. The process takes longer when there is no investment made by incarnate third-density beings.
excerpts.q: When this earth was second-density, how did the second-density beings on this earth become so invested?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. Much as you would put on a vestment, so do your third-density beings invest or clothe some second-density beings with self-awareness. This is often done through the opportunity of what you call pets. It has also been done by various other means of investiture. These include many so-called religious practice complexes which personify and send love to various natural second-density beings in their group form.
excerpts.q: Going back over this morning’s work, [inaudible]. You said the second density strives towards the third density, which is the density of self-consciousness, or self-awareness. The striving takes place through higher second-density forms invested by third-density beings. Could you explain what you mean by this?

excerpts.t: The other pyramids are not placed properly for earth healing but for healing of mind/body/spirit complexes. It came to our attention that your density was distorted towards, what is called by our distortion-understanding of third density, a premature aging process. We were attempting to aid in giving the mind/body/spirit complexes of third density on your planetary sphere more of a time/space continuum in one incarnation pattern in order to have a fuller opportunity to learn/teach the Laws, or Ways, of the primal distortion of the Law of One which is Love.
excerpts.q: Does the balancing refer to balancing of the individual who is initiated in the pyramid, or does it refer to the physical balancing of the earth on its axis in space?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. The balancing pyramidal structures could [be] and were used for individual initiation. However, the use of these pyramids was also designed for the balancing of the planetary energy web.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. This will be the final question of this time/space. There is the same difference between love/light and light/love as there is between teach/learning and learn/teaching. Love/light is the enabler, the power, the energy giver. Light/love is the manifestation which occurs when Light has been impressed with Love.
excerpts.q: You also said that you offered the Law of One, which is the balancing of love/light and light/love. Is there any difference between love/light and light/love?

excerpts.t: In a balanced individual each energy center is balanced and functioning brightly and fully. The blockages of your planetary sphere cause some distortion of intelligent energy. The blockages of the mind/body/spirit complex further distort, or unbalance, this energy. There is one energy. It may be understood as love/light, or light/love, or intelligent energy.
excerpts.q: Can you tell me a little bit about the definition of the word “balancing” as we are using it?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. Picture, if you will, the One Infinite. You have no picture. Thus, the process begins. Love creating Light, becoming love/light, streams into the planetary sphere according to the electromagnetic web of points, or nexi, of entrance. These streamings are then available to the individual who, like the planet, is a web of electromagnetic energy fields with points, or nexi, of entrance.

excerpts.t: I scan each and find it acceptable to share this information. The wanderers in this working are of two densities: one the density of five, that is, of light; one the density of love/light, or unity. To express the identity of which came from which density we observe to be an infringement upon the free will of each. Therefore, we state simply the two densities, both of which are harmoniously oriented towards work together.
excerpts.q: Is it possible for you to tell us anything about what—since we are wanderers—anything about our previous density? Which density we came from?
excerpts.post: I am Ra. I leave you in the love and the light of the Infinite Creator. Go forth, then, rejoicing in the power and the peace of the One Infinite Creator. Adonai.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The term “density” is a, what you would call, mathematical one. The closest analogy is that of music, whereby after seven notes on your western type of scale, if you will, the eighth note begins a new octave. Within your great octave of existence which we share with you, there are seven octaves or densities. Within each density there are seven sub-densities. Within each sub-density, seven sub-sub-densities, and so on infinitely.
excerpts.q: Could you define the word density as we have been using it to give us a little greater idea of the concept of this term when used by you?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. We are assuming that you intend all dimensions of consciousness, or densities of awareness, in this question. Approximately one-fifth of all planetary entities contain awareness of one or more densities. Some planetary spheres are hospitable only for certain densities. Your planetary sphere, for instance, is at this time hospitable to levels, or densities, one, two, three, and four.
excerpts.q: How many inhabited planets are there in our galaxy?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. We ask you to consider, as we speak, that there are no words for positively describing fourth density. We can only explain what is not and approximate what is. Beyond fourth density our ability grows more limited still until we become without words.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Is it possible for you to give a small description of the conditions in fourth density?
excerpts.post: That which fourth density is not: it is not of words, unless chosen. It is not of heavy chemical vehicles for body complex activities. It is not of disharmony within self. It is not of disharmony within peoples. It is not within limits of possibility to cause disharmony in any way.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The entity who wishes to pursue the path of service to self must attain a grade of five—that is five percent service to others, ninety-five percent service to self. It must approach totality. The negative path is quite difficult to attain harvestability upon and requires great dedication.
excerpts.q: What must be the entity’s percentage, shall we say, if he is to be harvested for the negative?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The one known to you as Jesus of Nazareth did not have a name. This entity was a member of fifth density of the highest level of that sub-octave. This entity was desirous of entering this planetary sphere in order to share the love vibration in as pure a manner as possible. Thus, this entity received permission to perform this mission. This entity was then a wanderer of no name, of Confederation origins, of fifth density, representing the fifth-density understanding of the vibration of understanding or love.
excerpts.q: Yes. What I meant to say was can you tell me if Jesus of Nazareth came from the Confederation before incarnation here?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. I have made an error. The fourth-density being is that which we intended to say, the highest level of fourth density going into the fifth. This entity could have gone on to the fifth but chose instead to return to third for this particular mission. This entity was of the highest sub-octave of the vibration of love. This is fourth density.
excerpts.q: Did you say the fifth vibration was that of love? Fifth density was that of love?

excerpts.t: Forgiveness of other-self is forgiveness of self. An understanding of this insists upon full forgiveness upon the conscious level of self and other-self, for they are one. A full forgiveness is thus impossible without the inclusion of self.
excerpts.q: You stated yesterday that forgiveness is the eradicator of karma. I am assuming that balanced forgiveness for the full eradication of karma would require forgiveness not only of other-selves, but forgiveness of self. Am I correct?
excerpts.pre: I am Ra. You are correct. We will briefly expand upon this understanding in order to clarify.

excerpts.t: It is, shall we say, a shortcut to simply ignore or overcome any desire. It must instead be understood and accepted. This takes patience and experience which can be analyzed with care, with compassion for self and for other-self.
excerpts.q: Thank you. I have a question here from Jim that I will read verbatim: “Much of the mystic tradition of seeking on Earth holds that belief that the individual self must be erased or obliterated and the material world ignored for an entity to reach ‘nirvana,’ as it’s called, or enlightenment. What is the proper role of the individual self and its worldly activities in aiding an entity to grow more into the Law of One?”
excerpts.pre: All things are acceptable in the proper time for each entity, and in experiencing, in understanding, in accepting, in then sharing with other-selves, the appropriate description shall be moving away from distortions of one kind to distortions of another which may be more consonant with the Law of One.

excerpts.t: We have found it to be inappropriate in the extreme to encourage the overcoming of any desires, except to suggest the imagination rather than the carrying out in the physical plane, as you call it, of those desires not consonant with the Law of One—this preserving the primal distortion of Free Will.
excerpts.q: Thank you. I have a question here from Jim that I will read verbatim: “Much of the mystic tradition of seeking on Earth holds that belief that the individual self must be erased or obliterated and the material world ignored for an entity to reach ‘nirvana,’ as it’s called, or enlightenment. What is the proper role of the individual self and its worldly activities in aiding an entity to grow more into the Law of One?”
excerpts.pre: The orientation develops due to analysis of desire. These desires become more and more distorted towards conscious application of love/light as the entity furnishes itself with distilled experience.
excerpts.post: The reason it is unwise to overcome is that overcoming is an unbalanced action creating difficulties in balancing in the time/space continuum. Overcoming thus creates the further environment for holding onto that which apparently has been overcome.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. This is incorrect. The second-density concept of serving self includes the serving of those associated with tribe or pack. This is not seen in second density as separation of self and other-self. All is seen as self since in some forms of second-density entities, if the tribe or pack becomes weakened, so does the entity within the tribe or pack.
excerpts.q: Then the newest third-density beings who’ve just made the transition from second are still strongly biased towards self-service. There must be many other mechanisms to create an awareness of the possibility of service to others. I am wondering, first—two things. I’m wondering about the mechanism, and I am wondering when the split takes place, where the entity is able to continue on the road towards service to self that will eventually take him to fourth or fifth density. […]

excerpts.t: I am Ra. We go back to previous information. Consider and remember the discussion of the Logos. With the primal distortion of free will, each galaxy developed its own Logos. This Logos has complete free will in determining the paths of intelligent energy which promote the lessons of each of the densities, given the conditions of the planetary spheres and the sun bodies.
excerpts.q: This seems to be a carefully planned, or engineered, stage of development. Can you tell me anything of the origin of this plan for the development?

excerpts.t: The new or initial third-density entity has this innocent, shall we say, bias or distortion towards viewing those in the family, the society, as you would call, perhaps, country, as self. Thus, though a distortion not helpful for progress in third density, it is without polarity.
excerpts.q: Then the newest third-density beings who’ve just made the transition from second are still strongly biased towards self-service. There must be many other mechanisms to create an awareness of the possibility of service to others. I am wondering, first—two things. I’m wondering about the mechanism, and I am wondering when the split takes place, where the entity is able to continue on the road towards service to self that will eventually take him to fourth or fifth density. […]
excerpts.post: The break becomes apparent when the entity perceives other-selves as other-selves and consciously determines to manipulate other-selves for the benefit of the self. This is the beginning of the road of which you speak.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The principle of crystal healing is based upon an understanding of the hierarchical nature of the structure of the illusion which is the physical body, as you would call it. There are crystals which work upon the energies coming into the spiritual body; there are crystals which work upon the distortions from spirit to mind; there are crystals which balance the distortions between the mind and the body. All of these crystal healings are charged through purified channels. Without the relative crystallization of the healer working with the crystal, the crystal will not be properly charged.
excerpts.q: We are very interested in the entire story that you have to tell and in getting into the Law of One in quite some detail. There will be several questions that I’ll ask as we go along that may or may not be related directly to understanding the Law of One. However, I believe that the proper way of presenting this as a teach/learning vehicle to the population of the planet that will read it, at this time, is to investigate different facets of what you tell us. You spoke of crystal healing. […]
excerpts.post: The other ingredient is a proper alignment with the energy fields of the planet upon which you dwell, and the holistic or cosmic distortions or streamings which enter the planetary aura in such a manner that an appropriate ratio of shapes and placement within these shapes is of indicated aid in the untangling or balancing process.

excerpts.t: Two, we wished then to carefully guide the initiates in developing a healing of the people whom they sought to aid and the planet itself. Pyramid after pyramid, charged by the crystal and initiate, were designed to balance the incoming energy of the One Creation with the many and multiple distortions of the planetary mind/body/spirit. In this effort we were able to continue work that brothers within the Confederation had effected through building of other crystal-bearing structures and thus complete a ring, if you will, of these about the earth’s, as this instrument would have us vibrate it, surface.
excerpts.q: Yes. You mentioned that the pyramids were an outgrowth of this. Could you expand a little bit on— Were you responsible for the building of the pyramid, and what was the purpose of the pyramid?
excerpts.pre: Firstly, to have a properly oriented place of initiation for those who wished to become purified or initiated channels for the Law of One.
excerpts.post: This instrument begins to lose energy. We ask for one more query or subject, and then we shall take our leave for this time/space.

excerpts.t: We came and were welcomed by the peoples whom we wished to serve. We attempted to aid them in technical ways having to do with the healing of mind/body/spirit-complex distortions through the use of the crystal, appropriate to the distortion, placed within a certain appropriate series of ratios of time/space material. Thus were the pyramids created.
excerpts.q: Could you tell us something of your historical background, your earlier times in the illusion, possibly your incarnation on this planet that you spoke of before, and contact with earlier races on this planet? Then we would have something to start with in writing this book.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. Perhaps the most common occurrence of second-density graduation during third-density cycle is the so-called pet: the animal which is exposed to the individualizing influences of the bond between animal and third-density entity. This individuation causes a sharp rise in the potential of the second-density entity so that, upon the cessation of physical complex, the mind/body complex does not return unto the undifferentiated consciousness of that species, if you will.
excerpts.q: So more and more second-density entities are making it into third density. Can you give me an example of a second-density entity coming into third density, say, in the recent past?

excerpts.t: It is, however, more toward the median, or mean, shall we say, of third-density developments throughout the one infinite universe that there be a small harvest after the first cycle; the remainder having significantly polarized, the second cycle having a much larger harvest; the remainder being even more significantly polarized, the third cycle culminating the process and the harvest being completed.
excerpts.q: I will make this assumption, then: if maximum efficiency had been achieved in this 25,000-year period the entities would have polarized either toward service toward self or service to others, one or the other. This would have then made them harvestable at the end of that 25,000-year period to either service-to-self or service-to-others type of fourth density, in which case they would have had to move to another planet because this one would have been in third density for fifty more thousand years. Is this correct?
excerpts.pre: The original desire is that entities seek and become one. If entities can do this in a moment, they may go forward in a moment; and thus were this to occur in a major cycle, indeed the third-density planet would be vacated at the end of that cycle.

excerpts.t: It is often the case that a third-density planetary cycle will take place in such a way that there need be no outside, shall we say, or other-self aid in the form of information. Rather, the entities themselves are able to work themselves towards the appropriate polarizations and goals of third-density learn/teachings.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Now, back in the first 25,000-year period, or major cycle, what type of aid was given by the Confederation to the entities who were in this 25,000-year period so that they could have the opportunity to grow?
excerpts.pre: For the most part the participation was limited, as it was appropriate to allow the full travel of the workings of the confusion mechanism to operate in order for the planetary entities to develop that which they wished in, shall we say, freedom within their own thinking.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. This query is more complex than most. We shall begin. The incarnation pattern of the beginning third-density mind/body/spirit complex begins in darkness, for you may think, or consider, of your density as one of, as you may say, a sleep and a forgetting. This is the only plane of forgetting. It is necessary for the third-density entity to forget so that the mechanisms of confusion, or free will, may operate upon the newly individuated consciousness complex.
excerpts.q: Now, when the 75,000-year cycle started, the life span was approximately nine hundred years, average. What was the process and scheduling of… mechanism, shall I say, of reincarnation at that time, and how did the time in between incarnations into third-density physical apply to the growth of the mind/body/spirit complex?
excerpts.post: Thus, the beginning entity is one in all innocence oriented towards animalistic behavior using other-selves only as extensions of self for the preservation of the all-self. The entity becomes slowly aware that it has needs, shall we say, that are not animalistic; that is, that are useless for survival. These needs include: the need for companionship, the need for laughter, the need for beauty, the need to know the universe about it. These are the beginning needs.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. There dwell within the Confederation planetary entities who, from their planetary spheres, do nothing but send love and light as pure streamings to those who call. This is not in the form of conceptual thought but of pure and undifferentiated love.
excerpts.q: How did the Confederation send this love and light? Precisely what did they do?

excerpts.t: Thus the time, as you may understand it, between incarnations is lengthened to give appropriate attention to the review and the healing of experiences of the previous incarnation. At some point in third density, the green-ray energy center becomes activated, and at that point incarnation ceases to be automatic.
excerpts.q: Now, when the 75,000-year cycle started, the life span was approximately nine hundred years, average. What was the process and scheduling of… mechanism, shall I say, of reincarnation at that time, and how did the time in between incarnations into third-density physical apply to the growth of the mind/body/spirit complex?
excerpts.pre: During the first portion of third-density cycles, incarnations are automatic and occur rapidly upon the cessation of energy complex of the physical vehicle. There is small need to review or to heal the experiences of the incarnation. As, what you would call, the energy centers begin to be activated to a higher extent, more of the content of experience during incarnation deals with the lessons of love.

excerpts.t: I am Ra. This is correct. As a group they stayed. There were those peripherally associated with this culture which did not stay. However, they were not able to be harvested either and so, beginning at the very highest, shall we say, of the sub-octaves of third density, repeated this density. Many of those who have been of a loving nature are not wanderers but those of this particular origin of second cycle.
excerpts.q: And did all of these entities then decide to stay and help during the next 25,000-year cycle?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The Council of Saturn acted only in allowing the entry into third density of other mind/body/spirit complexes of third density, not wanderers, but those who sought further third-density experience. This was done randomly so that free will would not be violated, for there was not yet a call.
excerpts.q: Was any action taken immediately, or did you wait for a call?

excerpts.t: I am Ra. The one known as sound vibration complex, Saint Augustine, is of such a nature. The one known as Saint Teresa of such a nature. The one known as Saint Francis of Assisi of such nature. These entities, being of monastic background, as you would call it, found incarnation in the same type of ambiance appropriate for further learning.
excerpts.q: Were any of these entities names that we know from our historical past? That have appeared as incarnated beings we find in our history?

excerpts.t: These pyramids were somewhat at variance from the design that we had promulgated. However, the original ideas were the same with the addition of a desire, or intention, of creating places of meditation and rest, a feeling of the presence of the One Creator; these pyramids then being for all people, not only initiates and those to be healed.
excerpts.q: Thank you. Now, I understand, if I am correct, that a South American contact was also made. Can you tell me of the… approximately the same question I asked about your contact, with respect to the attitude or… about the contact, and its ramifications, and the plan for the contact, and why the people were contacted in South America?
excerpts.pre: Thus, these entities were visited by light beings not unlike ourselves. Instructions were given, and they were more accepted and less distorted than ours. The entities themselves began to construct a series of underground and hidden cities including pyramid structures.
excerpts.post: They left this density when it was discovered that their plans were solidly in motion and, in fact, had been recorded. During the next approximately three thousand five hundred [3,500] years these plans became, though somewhat distorted, in a state of near-completion in many aspects.

excerpts.t: Meanwhile, the information concerning initiation and healing by crystal was being given. The one known as “Akhenaten” was able to perceive this information without significant distortion and, for a time, moved, shall we say, heaven and earth in order to invoke the Law of One and to order the priesthood of these structures in accordance with the distortions of initiation and true compassionate healing.
